+class ExpertsGeometry:
+    """Static plain-input geometry. No cluster-local or multicast storage. The workspace
+    is capacity-independent; capacity > 8 swaps the batch's SMEM activation image for
+    per-slot 8-row images, which frees a sixth weight stage, and keeps per-CTA windows
+    of the unit tables (expert, 8 pair rows) in the misc block."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tp, capacity=8):
+        self.tp = tp
+        self.tiles, self.w13_rows, self.h_chunks, self.fc2_stages = (
+            (6, 768, 3, 2) if tp == 8 else (3, 512, 2, 1)
+        )
+        self.grouped = capacity > 8
+        self.stages = stages = 6 if self.grouped else 5
+        self.units = 16 * capacity if self.grouped else 128
+        self.w13_scale_bytes = self.w13_rows * 112
+        self.w2_scale_columns = 4 * self.h_chunks
+        self.w2_scale_bytes = 3584 * self.w2_scale_columns
+        self.w2_tile_scale_bytes = 128 * self.w2_scale_columns
+        self.h_image_bytes = self.h_chunks * 1024
+        self.h_scale_bytes = self.h_chunks * 128 + 384
+        self.h_compact_bytes = self.h_image_bytes + 128
+        self.off_sfa = stages * 32768
+        self.off_x = self.off_sfa + stages * 1024
+        self.off_h = self.off_x + (stages * 2048 if self.grouped else 28672)
+        self.off_xsf = self.off_h + 2 * self.h_image_bytes
+        self.off_hsf = self.off_xsf + (stages * 256 if self.grouped else 28 * 128) + 384
+        self.off_misc = self.off_hsf + 2 * self.h_scale_bytes
+        self.smem_bytes = self.off_misc + 5120
+        # Misc barriers (byte offsets): weight full/empty [stages], accumulator
+        # full/empty [16], hidden full/empty [2], x ready [14]. Grouped stage metadata
+        # and unit windows (4 x 16 units) use the B<=8 routing tables' space.
+        self.bar_full, self.bar_empty, self.bar_accfull = (0, 8 * stages, 16 * stages)
+        acc = self.bar_accfull
+        self.bar_accempty, self.bar_hfull = (acc + 128, acc + 256)
+        self.bar_hempty, self.bar_xready = (acc + 272, acc + 288)
+        self.off_meta = self.off_misc + (1152 if self.grouped else 520)
+        self.off_window = self.off_misc + 1280
+        # Stealing: FC2 unit queue (producer -> hidden loader) [8], full/empty [8, 8].
+        self.off_queue, self.bar_queue = (self.off_misc + 4608, 4640)
+        self.ws_partial = 2 * 128 * self.h_compact_bytes
+        self.ws_counter = self.ws_partial + 2 * 160 * 8 * 128 * 4
+        self.ws_xflag = self.ws_counter + 160 * 4
+        self.ws_stage = (self.ws_xflag + 160 * 4 + 255) // 256 * 256
+        # Publish stage rows [64 tokens x 16 slots, 3584] BF16, then grouped: call
+        # counters [160] and unit counts [2], hidden images [2, 1024].
+        self.ws_calls = self.ws_stage + 1024 * 3584 * 2
+        self.ws_units = self.ws_calls + 1024
+        # Pregrouped unit table (``ExpertsGroupKernel``): header (units, call, grouped
+        # call), experts [1024], rows [1024, 8].
+        self.ws_group = self.ws_units + 2 * 1024 * self.h_compact_bytes
+        # FC2(B) tail claim counters [2 parities, 160] (``ExpertsKernel.steal``).
+        self.ws_steal = self.ws_group + 16 + 20 * 1024
+        self.workspace_bytes = self.ws_steal + 2 * 160 * 4
+
+    def image(self, workspace, parity, unit):
+        """Compact hidden image of ``unit`` in the ``parity`` half of the workspace."""
+        if self.grouped:
+            base = workspace.iterator + self.ws_units
+            return base + (Int64(parity) * 1024 + unit) * self.h_compact_bytes
+        return workspace.iterator + (Int64(parity) * 128 + unit) * self.h_compact_bytes
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def swizzled(chunk, row, base=0):
+    """Byte offset of 16-byte ``chunk`` of ``row`` in a 128B-swizzled 8-row image."""
+    return base + chunk // 8 * 1024 + row * 128 + (chunk % 8 ^ row) * 16
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def has_ff_byte(word: Uint32):
+    value = ~word
+    return value - Uint32(16843009) & ~value & Uint32(2155905152) != 0
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def mx_block(words):
+    """MXFP8 of one 32-BF16 block (16 words): eight e4m3x4 words and the E8M0 scale."""
+    values = cute.make_rmem_tensor(32, Float32)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        pair = unpack_bf16(words[i])
+        values[2 * i], values[2 * i + 1] = (pair[0], pair[1])
+    maxima = cute.make_rmem_tensor(16, Float32)
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        maxima[j] = cute.arch.fmax(abs(values[j]), abs(values[j + 16]))
+    for width in (8, 4, 2, 1):
+        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+            maxima[j] = cute.arch.fmax(maxima[j], maxima[j + width])
+    scale = mx_exponent(maxima[0])
+    reciprocal = mx_rescale(scale)
+    packed = [
+        pack_fp8(tuple(values[4 * j + i] * reciprocal for i in range(4)))
+        for j in range(8)
+    ]
+    return packed, scale
+
+
+# Grouped expert plan, written before the experts run (by the routing kernel's copy
+# role, or ExpertsPlanKernel): MXFP8 rows [64, 3584] then scale words [64, 28, 16 B]
+# (bytes 0-3 used), the layout of the experts' per-slot SMEM images.
+PLAN_XSF = 64 * 3584
+PLAN_BYTES = PLAN_XSF + 64 * 448
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def plan_chunk(plan, token, chunk, words):
+    """Write 8-element ``chunk`` (four BF16x2 ``words``) of ``token`` as MXFP8 into
+    the plan; lanes 4k..4k+3 hold one 32-element block, 16 lanes one scale word.
+    Bit-identical to ``mx_block`` (an exact max, the same scaling and packing)."""
+    lane, values = (thread()[2], cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Float32))
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        pair = unpack_bf16(words[i])
+        values[2 * i], values[2 * i + 1] = (pair[0], pair[1])
+    top = abs(values[0])
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, 8):
+        top = cute.arch.fmax(top, abs(values[i]))
+    for width in (1, 2):
+        top = cute.arch.fmax(top, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(top, width))
+    scale = mx_exponent(top)
+    reciprocal = mx_rescale(scale)
+    packed = [
+        pack_fp8(tuple(values[4 * j + i] * reciprocal for i in range(4)))
+        for j in range(2)
+    ]
+    store_words(plan.iterator + token * 3584 + chunk * 8, packed)
+    word = Uint32(scale)
+    for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, 4):
+        word |= shuffle(Uint32(scale), lane + 4 * s) << 8 * s
+    if chunk % 16 == 0:
+        dst = plan.iterator + PLAN_XSF + token * 448 + chunk // 16 * 16
+        store_words(dst, (word, Uint32(0), Uint32(0), Uint32(0)))
+
+
+class ExpertsPlanKernel:
+    """Standalone plan writer (no routing kernel in front): one CTA per token."""
+
+    def __init__(self, batch):
+        self.batch = batch
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        launch(self.kernel, args, self.batch, 256)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        x, plan = args
+        tid, _, _, token = thread()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            chunk = tid + 256 * i
+            if chunk < 448:  # warp-uniform: chunks 256-447 are warps 0-5
+                words = load_words(
+                    x.iterator + token * 3584 + chunk * 8, count=4, mutable=True
+                )
+                plan_chunk(plan, token, chunk, words)
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+
+
+@asm()
+def stage(mma, weight_scales, activation_scales, release, done, *, kind):
+    """One FC1/FC2 stage. ``mma``: (TMEM accumulator, weight desc, activation desc);
+    scales: (TMEM column, desc[, activation copy flag]); ``release``: (FC1 accumulate
+    or FC2 prior-H release, weight empty barrier); ``done``: accumulator barrier."""
+    half = kind in ("fc2b", "fc2p")
+    steps = 6 if kind == "fc2" else 4 if half else 8
+    cp = "tcgen05.cp.cta_group::1.32x128b.warpx4"
+    arrive = "tcgen05.commit.cta_group::1.mbarrier::arrive::one.shared::cluster.b64"
+    code = [
+        "{ .reg .pred e,p0,pt,pc,pa,ph; .reg .b32 i<4>; .reg .b64 as1,bs1,bs2;",
+        f".reg .b32 af1,bf1,bf2; .reg .b64 xa<{steps}>,xb<{steps}>;",
+        "elect.sync _|e,0xffffffff; setp.eq.b32 pt,0,0; setp.ne.b32 pc,$7,0;",
+        "and.pred pc,pc,e; setp.ne.b32 pa,$10,0; and.pred pa,pa,e;",
+    ]
+    if kind == "fc1":
+        code.append("setp.ne.b32 p0,$8,0;")
+    elif half:
+        code.append("setp.eq.b32 p0,0,0;")
+    else:
+        code.append("setp.eq.b32 p0,0,1; setp.ne.b32 ph,$8,0; and.pred ph,ph,e;")
+        code.append(f"@ph {arrive} [$8];")
+    code += [f"mov.b32 i{k},{142738048 | k << 29 | k << 4};" for k in range(4)]
+    if not half:
+        code.append("add.s64 as1,$4,32; add.s64 bs1,$6,8;")
+        code.append("add.u32 af1,$3,4; add.u32 bf1,$5,4;")
+        if kind == "fc2a":
+            code.append("add.s64 bs2,$6,16; add.u32 bf2,$5,8;")
+        code += [f"@pc {cp} [$5],$6;", f"@pc {cp} [bf1],bs1;"]
+        if kind == "fc2a":
+            code.append(f"@pc {cp} [bf2],bs2;")
+    code.append(f"@e {cp} [$3],$4;")
+    if not half:
+        code.append(f"@e {cp} [af1],as1;")
+    for k in range(steps):
+        a = k // 4 * 1024 + k % 4 * 2 + (4 if kind == "fc2" and k >= 4 else 0)
+        b = k // 4 * 64 + k % 4 * 2
+        code.append(f"add.s64 xa{k},$1,{a}; add.s64 xb{k},$2,{b};")
+    for k in range(steps):
+        af, bf = ("$3", "$5") if k < 4 else ("af1", "bf1")
+        code.append(
+            "@e tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1.kind::mxf8f6f4.block_scale "
+            f"[$0],xa{k},xb{k},i{k % 4},[{af}],[{bf}],{'p0' if k == 0 else 'pt'};"
+        )
+    if kind != "fc2p":
+        code.append(f"@e {arrive} [$9];")
+    if kind != "fc2a":
+        code.append(f"@pa {arrive} [$10];")
+    code.append("}")
+    kinds = "rllrlrlrrrr"
+    operands = (*mma, *weight_scales, *activation_scales, *release, done)
+    values = [(Uint64 if k == "l" else Uint32)(v) for k, v in zip(kinds, operands)]
+    return "\n".join(code), ",".join(kinds) + ",~{memory}", values
+
+
+@asm(Uint32)
+def claim(pointer, value):
+    """Relaxed GPU-scope fetch-add (FC2 tail claims): the counter before the add."""
+    code = "atom.relaxed.gpu.global.add.u32 $0,[$1],$2;"
+    return code, "=r,l,r,~{memory}", (pointer, Uint32(value))
+
+
+def fc2_pairs(tp, capacity, streamed):
+    """TP8 FC2 jobs are tile pairs on the incremental producer from capacity 4 (the
+    grouped engine always streams): chunks 0-1 of tiles t and t + 1, then both tiles'
+    chunk 2 through one 256-row box (map 5), so every stage is 16 KB."""
+    return tp == 8 and streamed and capacity >= 4
+
+
+class ExpertsKernel(ExpertsGeometry):
+    """The engine for one capacity and persistent grid. CTAs wait on other clusters'
+    partials (``load_hidden``, ``partials``, ``finalize``), so
+    ``PersistentExperts.prepare`` checks the grid is co-resident. It is not launched
+    cooperatively: that forfeits the PDL prologue overlap (1-2% decode at B4-B8).
+    ``publish`` stages FC2 rows for ``finalize``: routing weights replace the output
+    arg, and (latent multicast, parity, rank) follow the SiTU scalars; ``"twoshot"``:
+    (receive slots [3 x TP, 64, 3584/TP], their owners' bases, parity x TP + rank) of
+    ``common.twoshot`` instead. Capacity > 8 (grouped) takes the plan (``PLAN_BYTES``:
+    MXFP8 x) in place of x. ``stream`` runs capacity <= 8 on the incremental producer
+    and CTA-scoped waits (grouped always). ``pregrouped`` (grouped) reads the unit table
+    ``ExpertsGroupKernel`` left in the workspace instead of grouping the routes itself.
+    ``steal`` (grouped) balances the end: each CTA's last ``zone`` FC2(B) grains (TP8 a
+    tile pair, TP16 three tiles) are claimed by the owner from the front and by the
+    ``victims`` CTAs before it from the back, through one counter per CTA re-armed by
+    call parity; a stolen grain is computed exactly as by its owner."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, tp, capacity, experts, grid, publish=False,
+        stream=True, pregrouped=False, steal=False,
+    ):  # fmt: skip
+        super().__init__(tp, capacity)
+        self.pregrouped = pregrouped and self.grouped
+        self.steal = steal and self.grouped
+        self.streamed = stream or self.grouped
+        self.paired = fc2_pairs(tp, capacity, self.streamed)
+        self.jobs = 14 if self.paired else 28  # FC2 jobs per unit
+        self.grain, self.zone, self.victims = (1 if self.paired else 3, 8, 3)
+        self.threads = 384
+        self.capacity, self.experts, self.grid = (capacity, experts, grid)
+        self.publish = publish
+        assert not self.grouped or grid >= capacity <= 64
+        self.width = min(capacity, 8)
+        self.dense = capacity <= 4

+                hi = lo + self.grain

+"""Prepared MoE provider: one model owner serializes its scratch, no tensor pointers
+are rebound at execution, and the side stream joins before the tail."""
+
+import torch
+
+from ..common.policy import batch_table
+from .experts_runtime import scratch as expert_scratch
+from .shared import scratch as shared_scratch
+
+
+class MoEScratch:
+    def __init__(self, tp, device, batches):
+        self.tp, self.device, self.batches = tp, torch.device(device), tuple(batches)
+        cap, h = max(batches), 6144 // tp
+        with torch.accelerator.device_index(self.device.index):
+            self.stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=self.device)
+            self.begin, self.shared_done = torch.cuda.Event(), torch.cuda.Event()
+            self.gate_done = torch.cuda.Event()  # the split shared expert's front half
+            f32, i32, bf16 = torch.float32, torch.int32, torch.bfloat16
+            empty = lambda s, t=bf16: torch.empty(s, dtype=t, device=self.device)
+            self.latent = empty((cap, 3584))
+            self.front: tuple = (empty((cap, 896), f32), empty((cap, 2 * h), f32))
+            self.front += (empty((cap, 16), i32), empty((cap, 16)), empty((cap, h)))
+            self.front += (empty((cap, 7168)), self.latent)
+            self.expanded = empty((cap * 16, 3584))
+            self.experts = expert_scratch(tp, self.device)
+            # The experts' plan (MXFP8 x), written by the routing kernel at B>8.
+            self.plan = self.experts["plan"]
+            self.shared = shared_scratch(self.device)  # fused shared-expert counters
+        self.views = {}
+        for b in batches:
+            self.views[b] = (self.latent[:b], self.expanded[: b * 16], self.experts)
+
+
+# TP8 B16: the experts start beside the split gate/up half (+1% E2E).
+JOIN = {8: "9-16:0", 16: ""}
+
+
+class PreparedMoE:
+    def __init__(self, front, experts, tail, state, *, prefetch=None, layer_idx=None):
+        self.front, self.experts, self.tail, self.state = front, experts, tail, state
+        self.prefetch, self.layer_idx = prefetch, layer_idx
+        self.small_batch = None  # optional small-batch chain
+        # Split batches whose routed experts launch beside the shared expert's
+        # gate/up half instead of after it.
+        self.join = batch_table(JOIN[state.tp])
+        self.sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(state.device).multi_processor_count
+        for b, sms in front.split.items():  # the split's down CTAs take the SMs left
+            experts.grids[b] = min(experts.grid_for(b), self.sms - sms)
+        for b in state.batches:
+            _, expanded, buffers = state.views[b]
+            publish, planned = tail.publish.get(b, ()), front.planned(b)
+            twoshot = b in tail.twoshots
+            experts.prepare(b, buffers, expanded, publish, planned, twoshot, True)
+
+    def run(self, x, out, *, consume=None):
+        state, b = self.state, x.shape[0]
+        if self.small_batch is not None and b in self.small_batch.batches:
+            return self.small_batch.run(out, consume)
+        main = torch.cuda.current_stream(state.device)
+        # The shared expert runs on the side stream beside the routed experts, or, when
+        # the persistent expert grid spans every SM, beside the front only. Split: its
+        # gate/up half beside the front, its down rows beside the experts.
+        before = self.experts.grid_for(b) >= self.sms
+        if self.front.merged_batch(b):
+            # One kernel publishes the routing logits and leaves h; the down rows then
+            # run beside the experts.
+            ids, weights, latent = self.front.route(x)
+            state.begin.record(main)
+            with torch.cuda.stream(state.stream):
+                state.stream.wait_event(state.begin)
+                shared, beside = self.front.shared_expert(x, self.tail)
+                beside()
+                state.shared_done.record(state.stream)
+            self.experts.group(ids)
+            return self.finish(b, out, latent, ids, weights, shared, consume)
+        state.begin.record(main)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(state.stream):
+            state.stream.wait_event(state.begin)
+            shared, beside = self.front.shared_expert(x, self.tail)
+            if beside is not None:
+                state.gate_done.record(state.stream)
+                beside()
+            state.shared_done.record(state.stream)
+        ids, weights, latent = self.front.route(x)
+        self.experts.group(ids)  # pregrouped unit table, beside the shared expert
+        if before or (beside is not None and self.join.get(b, 1)):
+            main.wait_event(state.shared_done if before else state.gate_done)
+        return self.finish(b, out, latent, ids, weights, shared, consume, before)
+
+    def finish(self, b, out, latent, ids, weights, shared, consume, before=False):
+        """The routed experts, the next layer's prefetch fork, then the tail once the
+        shared expert's side stream is done."""
+        main = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.state.device)
+        expanded = self.experts.run(latent, ids, weights)
+        if self.prefetch is not None:
+            self.prefetch.fork("next_attention", self.layer_idx, b)
+        if not before:
+            main.wait_event(self.state.shared_done)
+        return self.tail.run(expanded, weights, shared, out, consume=consume)

+    def owned_h(self, h, parts, staged, m, rank, beta, linear_beta):
+        """Owner of gate/up tile ``m``: SiTU of the summed parts into ``width``-column
+        h vectors."""
+        tid, _, _, _ = thread()
+        batch, width = self.batch, self.width
+        for i in c.range_constexpr((width * batch + 127) // 128):
+            item = tid + 128 * i
+            if item < width * batch:
+                j, t = item // batch, item % batch
+                sums = [Float32(0), Float32(0)]
+                for source in c.range_constexpr(self.ks):
+                    for half in c.range_constexpr(2):
+                        cell = (source * 2 + half) * width + j
+                        sums[half] = sums[half] + parts[cell * self.n + self.slot(t, j)]
+                gate = Float32(c.BFloat16(sums[0]))
+                up = Float32(c.BFloat16(sums[1]))
+                value = c.BFloat16(situ(gate, up, beta, linear_beta))
+                staged[t * width + j] = value
+        named_barrier(1, 128)
+        if tid < batch:
+            row = staged.iterator + tid * width
+            words = smem_words(row) if width == 8 else smem_words(row, count=2)
+            store_words(at(h, tid, 32 * m + width * rank), words)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def publish(self, args, parts, rows, f, rank):
+        """Owner of front tile ``f``: sums each (row, token) in rank order, then
+        publishes ``width``-row vectors like the front GEMM: FP32 router logits (rows
+        < valid) and BF16 latent columns (rows >= split), -0 made +0, as multicast
+        stores into the front mailbox (``mc``; this rank's ``slot`` / ``base``)."""
+        mc, slot, base = args[10:13]
+        _, split, valid, pitch = self.front
+        tid, _, _, _ = thread()
+        batch, width = self.batch, self.width
+        shard: Constexpr = 3584 // self.tp
+        for i in c.range_constexpr((width * batch + 127) // 128):
+            item = tid + 128 * i
+            if item < width * batch:
+                j, t = item // batch, item % batch
+                for half in c.range_constexpr(2):
+                    total = Float32(0)
+                    for source in c.range_constexpr(self.ks):
+                        cell = (source * 2 + half) * width + j
+                        total = total + parts[cell * self.n + self.slot(t, j)]
+                    rows[(t * 2 + half) * (width + 1) + j] = total
+        named_barrier(1, 128)
+        if tid < 2 * batch:
+            t, half = tid // 2, tid % 2
+            row = 64 * f + 32 * half + width * rank
+            values = [rows[tid * (width + 1) + v] for v in range(width)]
+            if row < valid:
+                for v in c.range_constexpr(width // 4):
+                    words = tuple(positive_zero32(values[4 * v + i]) for i in range(4))
+                    offset = t * pitch + 3584 + 2 * (slot + row + 4 * v)
+                    multicast_words(mc + Int64(offset) * 2, words, kind="bf16x2")
+            elif (row >= split) & (row - split < shard):
+                pairs = range(0, width, 2)
+                words = tuple(positive_zero(values[i], values[i + 1]) for i in pairs)
+                offset = t * pitch + base + row - split
+                multicast_words(mc + Int64(offset) * 2, words, kind="bf16x2")
+
+
+class SharedDown(SharedBase):
+    """The split variant's down projection beside the routed experts: ``sms``
+    persistent CTAs (one per SM the experts' grid leaves) stage h [N, hidden] once,
+    take every ``sms``-th 64-row tile, stream its W blocks through a TMA ring (warp 5)
+    into alternating TMEM accumulators (warp 4) and peer-store each tile like the
+    fused kernel (warps 0-3). Exactly the fused kernel's down numerics."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tp, batch, sms, budget=200 * 1024):
+        super().__init__(tp, batch)
+        self.sms, self.image = sms, self.down * self.n * 128  # h as B tiles
+        ring = budget - self.image - self.n * 68 * 4
+        self.stages = min(24, ring // 8192)  # W [64, 64] K blocks (8 KB)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        options = dict(pdl=False, min_blocks_per_mp=1)
+        launch(self.kernel, args, self.sms, 192, **options)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        h, maps = args[0:2]
+        tid, warp, lane, cta = thread()
+        stages, columns = self.stages, self.columns
+        smem = c.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        image = alloc(smem, c.Uint8, self.image, 1024).iterator
+        ring = alloc(smem, c.Uint8, stages * 8192, 1024).iterator
+        staging = alloc(smem, c.Uint8, self.n * 68 * 4, 16).iterator
+        # full [stages], empty [stages], accumulator full [2] / empty [2], h ready
+        bars = alloc(smem, c.Uint64, 2 * stages + 5, 8).iterator
+        slot = alloc(smem, Uint32, 1)
+        acc_full, acc_empty, ready = (bars + 2 * stages + i for i in (0, 2, 4))
+        if tid == 0:
+            for s in c.range_constexpr(stages):
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(bars + s, 1)
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(bars + stages + s, 1)
+            for i in c.range_constexpr(2):
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(acc_full + i, 1)
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(acc_empty + i, 128)
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_init(ready, 128)
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_init_fence()
+        if warp == 4:
+            cute.arch.alloc_tmem(2 * columns, slot.iterator)
+            cute.arch.relinquish_tmem_alloc_permit()
+        fence_tmem(before=True)
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        fence_tmem()
+        tmem = slot[0]
+        tiles = (ROWS - cta + self.sms - 1) // self.sms
+        if warp < 4:
+            for j in c.range_constexpr(self.down):
+                self.load_rows(image + j * self.n * 128, h, 64 * j)
+            cute.arch.cp_async_mbarrier_arrive_noinc(ready)
+            for i in c.range(tiles, unroll=1):
+                wait(acc_full + i % 2, i // 2 % 2, scope="cta")
+                fence_tmem()
+                values = self.accumulated(tmem + Uint32(i % 2 * columns))
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive(acc_empty + i % 2)
+                self.push(args[2:6], staging, values, 64 * (cta + i * self.sms))
+        elif warp == 4:
+            self.multiply(image, ring, bars, tmem, tiles)
+        elif lane == 0:
+            down = maps.iterator + 128
+            acquire_tensormap(down)  # in the thread that issues its TMAs
+            for i in c.range(tiles, unroll=1):
+                row0 = 64 * (cta + i * self.sms)
+                for j in c.range(self.down, unroll=1):
+                    g = i * self.down + j
+                    s = g % stages
+                    if g >= stages:
+                        wait(bars + stages + s, (g // stages - 1) % 2, scope="cta")
+                    self.load_weight(
+                        ring + s * 8192, down, bars + s, row0, row0 + 32, 64 * j
+                    )
+        release_tmem(tmem, 2 * columns, warp, 4)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def multiply(self, image, ring, bars, tmem, tiles):
+        """Warp 4: each tile's K blocks into accumulator half i % 2."""
+        stages, columns = self.stages, self.columns
+        instruction: Constexpr = 1 << 4 | 1 << 7 | 1 << 10 | self.n >> 3 << 17 | 4 << 24
+        acc_full, acc_empty, ready = (bars + 2 * stages + i for i in (0, 2, 4))
+        total = tiles * self.down
+        wait(ready, 0, scope="cta")
+        cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+        for i in c.range(tiles, unroll=1):
+            if i >= 2:
+                wait(acc_empty + i % 2, (i // 2 - 1) % 2, scope="cta")
+            fence_tmem()
+            d = tmem + Uint32(i % 2 * columns)
+            for j in c.range(self.down, unroll=1):
+                g = i * self.down + j
+                s = g % stages
+                wait(bars + s, g // stages % 2, scope="cta")
+                fence_tmem()
+                a = smem_desc(ring + s * 8192, True)
+                b = smem_desc(image + j * self.n * 128, True)
+                release = Int32(g + stages < total)
+                mma_bf16_block(d, a, b, instruction, j, bars + stages + s, release)
+            self.elected(acc_full + i % 2)
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def compile_shared(tp, batch, device, gate=False, front=None):
+    """Arguments: x, ``weight_maps``, h, counters, RS peers, parity, rank, capacity,
+    beta, linear beta. ``gate``: the split variant's gate/up + SiTU half; ``front``
+    (rows, split, valid, mailbox row): with the MoE front GEMM's rows, whose results
+    go to the front mailbox (more arguments: multicast address, logit slot, latent
+    base; ``weight_maps`` with the front's)."""
+    maps = fake((256 if front is None else 384,), None, c.Uint8, 64)
+    args: tuple = (fake((batch, 7168)), maps, fake((batch, 6144 // tp)))
+    args += (fake((COUNTERS,), None, Int32), fake((tp,), None, Int64))
+    args += (Int32(0), Int32(0), Int32(0), Float32(4), Float32(25))
+    if front is not None:
+        args += (Int64(0), Int32(0), Int32(0))
+    ring = 80 * 1024 if front is None else FRONT_RING[tp]
+    kernel = SharedUmma(tp, batch, ring, gate, front)
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device):
+        return cute.compile(kernel, *args, make_fake_stream())
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def compile_down(tp, batch, device, sms):
+    """Arguments: h, ``weight_maps``, RS peers, parity, rank, capacity."""
+    args: tuple = (fake((batch, 6144 // tp)), fake((256,), None, c.Uint8, 64))
+    args += (fake((tp,), None, Int64), Int32(0), Int32(0), Int32(0))
+    kernel = SharedDown(tp, batch, sms)
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device):
+        return cute.compile(kernel, *args, make_fake_stream())
+
+
+def scratch(device):
+    """Model-owned fused shared-expert counters (zeroed; re-armed by each launch)."""
+    return torch.zeros(COUNTERS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Small-batch MoE chains: front -> routed experts -> (shared expert) -> polling tail.
+
+TP8 B1: ``MoeFrontTP8`` -> ``ClusterExpertsTP8`` -> ``MoeSharedTP8`` -> ``MoeTail``
+(front_poll, trigger 3). TP16 B1/B2: ``MoeFrontTP16`` (shared expert inside, on
+designated SMs) -> ``ClusterExpertsTP16`` -> ``MoeTail``. The o-projection consumer
+publishes the post-attention row into the x_moe mailbox (parity = layer index % 2) and
+bumps an epoch hint; the co-resident front has staged its weights by then. MoE tail
+polls the G/W/S slots (three parities, 0xffff-armed, re-armed after use) and publishes
+the next AttnRes input."""
+
+import functools
+
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import Float32, Float64, Int32, Uint64
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+from ...common.host import fake, layout, stream, to_cute
+from ...oproj.prepared import OprojMailbox
+from ..tail_runtime import POLL_CAP, compile_tail
+from .experts import ClusterExpertsTP8, ClusterExpertsTP16
+from .front_tp8 import MoeFrontTP8, MoeSharedTP8, SharedSituTables
+from .front_tp16 import MoeFrontTP16, initialize_designated
+
+# Kernel class and trailing scalar arguments of each small-batch launch.
+_KERNELS = {
+    "front": (MoeFrontTP8, (Int32,) * 3 + (Uint64, Float32)),
+    "front16": (MoeFrontTP16, (Int32,) * 3 + (Uint64,) + (Float32,) * 4 + (Float64,)),
+    "experts_tp16": (ClusterExpertsTP16, (Float32,) * 3),
+    "experts_tp8": (ClusterExpertsTP8, (Float32,) * 3),
+    "shared": (MoeSharedTP8, (Int32,) * 2),
+    "tables": (SharedSituTables, (Float32,) * 2),
+}
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _compile(kind, specs, device, *args, **kwargs):
+    kernel, scalars = _KERNELS[kind]
+    operands = [fake(*spec) for spec in specs] + [t(0) for t in scalars]
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device):
+        return cute.compile(kernel(*args, **kwargs), *operands, make_fake_stream())
+
+
+def _launch(kind, tensors, *args, **kwargs):
+    specs = tuple(map(layout, tensors))
+    code = _compile(kind, specs, tensors[0].device.index, *args, **kwargs)
+    return code, tuple(map(to_cute, tensors))
+
+
+def u32(t):
+    return t.view(torch.uint32)
+
+
+class SmallBatchBox:
+    """Model-owned small-batch storage, shared serially by every MoE layer."""
+
+    def __init__(self, group, device, tp, rank):
+        def armed(shape, fill, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+            value = torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+            value.view(torch.int32).fill_(fill)
+            return value
+
+        zeros = functools.partial(torch.zeros, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.tp, self.rank, self.device = tp, rank, device
+        self.sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).multi_processor_count
+        self.xmoe = armed((2, 1, 4, 7168), -0x80000000)
+        self.epoch = zeros(256)
+        self.scores = armed((7168,), -0x80000000, torch.int32)
+        self.ids = armed((16,), -1, torch.int32)
+        self.w, self.s = armed((3, POLL_CAP, 16), -1), armed((3, POLL_CAP, 7168), -1)
+        self.g = armed((3, POLL_CAP * 16, 3584), -1)
+        self.h2 = OprojMailbox(group, device, tp, rank, (2, POLL_CAP, 3584))
+        self.latent = zeros(3584, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.hg, self.counter = zeros(6144), zeros(1)
+        self.tables = {}
+        self.batches = (1,) if tp == 8 else (1, 2)
+        if tp == 16:  # resident-SM placement mask plus per-batch route/gate scratch
+            self.designated = zeros(self.sms + 16)
+            initialize_designated(self.designated)
+            self.scratch, i32 = {}, torch.int32
+            for b in self.batches:
+                scores = armed((2 * b * 896 * 2,), -0x80000000, i32)
+                self.scratch[b] = scores, armed((b * 16,), -1, i32), zeros(2 * b * 768)
+        self.front_views = tuple(self.xmoe[p] for p in range(2))
+        self.hint_views = tuple(self.epoch[p * 32 : p * 32 + 224] for p in range(2))
+
+    def situ_tables(self, beta, linear_beta):
+        key = float(beta), float(linear_beta)
+        if key not in self.tables:
+            table = torch.empty(131072, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
+            code, args = _launch("tables", (table,))
+            code(*args, Float32(beta), Float32(linear_beta), stream(self.device))
+            self.tables[key] = table
+        return self.tables[key]
+
+
+class SmallBatchChain:
+    """One MoE layer's small-batch chain; MoE tail weights come from the layer's
+    prepared tail."""
+
+    def __init__(self, box, moe, experts, tail, layer_idx, beta, linear_beta, prefetch):
+        self.box, self.tail_weights, self.tail_box = (
+            box,
+            tail.tail_weights,
+            tail.tail_box,
+        )
+        self.prefetch, self.layer_idx = prefetch, layer_idx
+        self.parity, self.slot = layer_idx % 2, int(tail.tail_weights.parity)
+        self.batches, shared = box.batches, moe.shared_experts
+        router, bias = moe.gate.weight, moe.gate.e_score_correction_bias
+        gate_up, shared_down = shared.gate_up_proj.weight, shared.down_proj.weight
+        rows = 3584 // box.tp
+        down = moe.routed_expert_down_proj.weight.narrow(0, box.rank * rows, rows)
+        scales = tuple(experts.weights[i].view(torch.uint8).reshape(-1) for i in (1, 3))
+        scale, renorm = moe.routed_scaling_factor, moe.moe_renormalize
+        self.scalars: tuple = (Int32(box.rank), Uint64(box.h2.mc), Float32(scale))
+        head: tuple = (router, bias, box.xmoe, u32(box.epoch))
+        if box.tp == 8:
+            tensors = head + (u32(box.scores), box.ids, box.w, down, box.h2.buffer)
+            tensors += (box.latent, gate_up, u32(box.hg))
+            self.front = _launch("front", tensors, grid=box.sms - 8, renorm=renorm)
+            tables = box.situ_tables(beta, linear_beta)
+            tensors = (box.xmoe, shared_down, tables, u32(box.hg), box.s)
+            self.shared = _launch("shared", tensors, grid=box.sms - 96)
+            tensors = (box.latent, box.ids, experts.maps[256:640].view(3, 128), *scales)
+            routed, args = _launch(
+                "experts_tp8", tensors + (box.g[self.slot, :16], box.counter)
+            )
+            self.routed = routed, args + experts.scalars
+            self.tail = compile_tail(8, 1, box.device.index, "front_poll", 3)
+            return
+        maps, self.codes = experts.maps[:256].view(2, 128), {}
+        for b in self.batches:
+            scores, ids, hg = box.scratch[b]
+            tensors = head + (u32(scores), ids, box.w, down, box.h2.buffer, gate_up)
+            tensors += (u32(hg), shared_down, box.s, box.designated)
+            front = _launch("front16", tensors, b, grid=box.sms - 7 * b, renorm=renorm)
+            latent = box.h2.buffer[self.parity, :b].reshape(-1)
+            g = box.g[self.slot, : b * 16]
+            routed = _launch("experts_tp16", (latent, ids, maps, *scales, g), b)
+            tail = compile_tail(16, b, box.device.index, "front_poll", 2)
+            self.codes[b] = front, routed, tail
+        lb = linear_beta
+        self.scalars += (Float32(beta), Float32(1 / beta), Float32(lb), Float64(1 / lb))
+        self.experts = experts.scalars
+
+    def run(self, out, consume):
+        b, s = out.shape[0], stream(self.box.device)
+        par, slot = Int32(self.parity), Int32(self.slot)
+        if self.box.tp == 8:
+            self.front[0](*self.front[1], par, slot, *self.scalars, s)
+            self.routed[0](*self.routed[1], s)
+            self.shared[0](*self.shared[1], par, slot, s)
+            tail = self.tail
+        else:
+            (front, front_args), (routed, routed_args), tail = self.codes[b]
+            front(*front_args, par, slot, *self.scalars, s)
+            routed(*routed_args, *self.experts, s)
+        if self.prefetch is not None:
+            self.prefetch.fork("next_attention", self.layer_idx, b)
+        self.tail_weights.run(
+            self.tail_box, self.box.g, self.box.w, self.box.s, tail, b
+        )
+        if consume(out) is not out:
+            raise RuntimeError("MoE tail output must be consumed from its mailbox ring")
+        return out

+"""Small-batch routed experts: ``ClusterExpertsTP16`` (TP16 B1/B2, six-CTA split-K
+clusters exchanging quantized hidden rows) and ``ClusterExpertsTP8`` (TP8 B1, one
+six-CTA cluster per routing slot)."""

+from typing import Any
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint8, Uint32, Uint64
+from cutlass.cute.arch import store_async_dsmem
+
+from ...common.primitives import (
+    acquire_tensormap_asm,
+    alloc,
+    chunk_mma,
+    commit_asm,

+
+@cute.jit
+def quantize_mx8(packed, row):
+    """(E8M0 scale, FP8 words) of eight BF16 values; four lanes share a 32-block."""
+    values = cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Float32)
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        values[2 * k], values[2 * k + 1] = unpack_bf16(packed[row, k])
+    amax = Float32(0)
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        amax = max(amax, abs(values[k]))
+    for k in (1, 2):
+        amax = max(amax, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(amax, k))
+    sb = mx_exponent(amax)
+    rs = mx_rescale(sb)
+    lo, hi = (pack_fp8([values[4 * h + k] * rs for k in range(4)]) for h in (0, 1))
+    return sb, (lo, hi)
+
+
+class _ClusterExperts:
+    """Shared launch of the six-CTA-cluster expert kernels."""
+
+    kernel: Any
+    threads: int
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        launch(self.kernel, args, 96, self.threads, cluster=6, min_blocks_per_mp=1)
+
+
+class ClusterExpertsTP16(_ClusterExperts):
+    """Paired CTAs split FC1 and exchange quantized hidden rows; the TP16 intermediate
+    has 192 live values padded to 256. IDs [B, 16], x BF16 [B, 3584], output BF16
+    [B * 16, 3584]. Polled IDs are re-armed per cluster; the caller re-arms latent rows
+    after all consumers complete."""
+
+    threads = 288
+
+    def __init__(self, batch: int):
+        """Polled IDs and latent rows; successors are released before the final wait."""
+        self.batch = batch
+        self.off_sfa = 6 * 32768
+        self.off_x = self.off_sfa + 6 * 1024
+        self.off_h = self.off_x + 7 * 2048
+        self.off_xsf = self.off_h + batch * 2048
+        self.off_hsf = self.off_xsf + 14 * 128 + 384
+        self.off_partial = self.off_hsf + batch * 1152
+        self.off_misc = self.off_partial + batch * 256
+        self.off_acc1 = self.off_misc + 104
+        self.off_acc2 = self.off_acc1 + batch * 8
+        self.off_precv = self.off_acc2 + batch * 40
+        self.off_hrecv = self.off_precv + batch * 8
+        self.off_tmem = self.off_hrecv + batch * 8
+        self.off_amax = self.off_tmem + 4
+        self.off_stage = (self.off_amax + batch * 16 + 15) // 16 * 16
+        # 512 B unused reserve keeps the tuned SMEM footprint.

+@asm()
+def sreg(name, dtype=Uint32, *, pure=False):
+    bits, kind = (64, "l") if dtype is Uint64 else (32, "r")
+    return f"mov.u{bits} $0,%{name};", f"={kind}", (), dtype, pure
+
+
+@asm(Uint32)
+def claim_add(pointer):
+    return "atom.relaxed.gpu.global.add.u32 $0,[$1],1;", "=r,l,~{memory}", (pointer,)
+
+
+@asm()
+def counter_reduce(pointer, value, *, op="add", release=False):
+    ordering = "release" if release else "relaxed"
+    code = f"red.{ordering}.gpu.global.{op}.{'b32' if op == 'or' else 'u32'} [$0],$1;"
+    return code, "l,r,~{memory}", (pointer, Uint32(value))
+
+
+@asm(Uint32)
+def load_arrivals(pointer):
+    return "ld.acquire.gpu.global.u32 $0,[$1];", "=r,l,~{memory}", (pointer,)
+

+class FrontPlacement:
+    """One claiming thread per CTA; every CTA publishes its arrival."""
+
+    def __init__(self, batch):
+        self.batch = batch
+        self.offset = 8 if batch == 2 else 0
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def claim(self, epoch, designated, par, cta):
+        pointer = epoch.iterator + (2 + par) * 32 + self.offset
+        sm = sreg("smid", pure=True)
+        claimed = Int32(-1)
+        if sm < designated.shape[0] - 16:  # noqa: SIM102 - preserve guarded load
+            if designated[sm] != 0:
+                claimed = Int32(claim_add(pointer))
+                counter_reduce(pointer + 2, Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF) - Uint32(cta), op="max")
+                if cutlass.const_expr(self.batch == 2):
+                    mask = pointer + 3 + (cta // 32)
+                    counter_reduce(mask, Uint32(1) << (cta % 32), op="or")
+        counter_reduce(pointer + 1, Uint32(1), release=True)
+        return claimed
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def rearm(self, epoch, par):
+        pointer = epoch.iterator + (2 + (par ^ 1)) * 32 + self.offset
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8 if self.batch == 2 else 3):
+            mailbox_store(pointer + i, (Uint32(0),))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def role(self, epoch, par, cta, claimed, grid):
+        pointer = epoch.iterator + (2 + par) * 32 + self.offset
+        count = Int32(0)
+        role = Int32(-1)
+        if claimed >= 0:
+            arrived = load_arrivals(pointer + 1)
+            while arrived < grid:
+                sleep_ns(64)
+                arrived = load_arrivals(pointer + 1)
+            count = Int32(mailbox_load(pointer)[0])
+            first = Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF) - mailbox_load(pointer + 2)[0]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.batch == 1):
+                role = claimed | (Int32(first == cta) << 16)
+            else:
+                order = Int32(0)
+                for word in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                    bits = mailbox_load(pointer + 3 + word)[0]
+                    if word < cta // 32:
+                        order += Int32(cute.arch.popc(bits))
+                    elif word == cta // 32:
+                        below = (Uint32(1) << (cta % 32)) - Uint32(1)
+                        order += Int32(cute.arch.popc(bits & below))
+                role = order | (Int32(order < 2) << 16)
+        return role, count
+

+class FrontPlacementProbe:
+    def __init__(self, cluster):
+        self.cluster = cluster
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        grid, smem = args[0].shape[0] // 2, 220 * 1024
+        launch(self.kernel, args, grid, 128, self.cluster, pdl=False, smem=smem)

+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        output, spin = args
+        tid, _, _, cta = thread()
+        sm, cluster = sreg("smid", pure=True), sreg("clusterid.x")
+        start = sreg("globaltimer", Uint64)
+        if tid == 0:
+            output[2 * cta] = Int32(sm)
+            output[2 * cta + 1] = Int32(cluster)
+        while sreg("globaltimer", Uint64) - start < spin:
+            pass

+@functools.cache
+def _compile_probe(device, cluster, length):
+    output = make_fake_tensor(Int32, (length,), (1,), assumed_align=16)
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device):
+        probe = FrontPlacementProbe(cluster)
+        return cute.compile(probe, output, Uint64(20000), make_fake_stream())

+def plan_designated(groups, *, engine_clusters=16, cluster_size=6):
+    """Largest-capacity-first plan of the routed-expert clusters over the SM groups."""
+    capacities = [len(group) // cluster_size for group in groups]
+    if sum(capacities) < engine_clusters:
+        raise ValueError("SM probe found insufficient routed-engine cluster capacity")
+    order = sorted(range(len(groups)), key=lambda i: (-capacities[i], -len(groups[i])))
+    counts = [0] * len(groups)
+    remaining = engine_clusters
+    for i in order:
+        counts[i] = min(capacities[i], remaining)
+        remaining -= counts[i]
+    keep = set()
+    for group, count in zip(groups, counts):
+        quota = len(group) - cluster_size * count
+        chosen: list[int] = []
+        for sm in sorted(group):
+            if sm % 2 == 0 and sm + 1 in group and len(chosen) + 2 <= quota:
+                chosen.extend((sm, sm + 1))
+        for sm in sorted(group):
+            if len(chosen) < quota and sm not in chosen:
+                chosen.append(sm)
+        keep.update(chosen)
+    return keep, counts
+

+def initialize_designated(table: torch.Tensor):
+    """Probe SM groups and fill the model-owned int32[nsm+16] table; returns CPU audit
+    data. Probe storage is freed before capture. Probes: 1- and 3-wave grids of
+    2..16-CTA clusters, 220 KiB SMEM (one CTA per SM), a 20 us global-timer spin."""
+    device = table.device
+    nsm = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).multi_processor_count
+    parent = list(range(4096))
+    seen = set()
+    launches = []
+
+    def find(sm):
+        while parent[sm] != sm:
+            parent[sm] = parent[parent[sm]]
+            sm = parent[sm]
+        return sm
+
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device.index):
+        stream = cuda.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream(device).cuda_stream)
+        for cluster in range(2, 17):
+            for waves in (1, 3):
+                clusters = max(1, (nsm // cluster) * waves)
+                output = table.new_full((2 * cluster * clusters,), -1)
+                try:
+                    compiled = _compile_probe(device.index, cluster, output.numel())
+                    compiled(to_cute(output), Uint64(20000), stream)
+                except RuntimeError as e:
+                    launches.append(dict(cluster=cluster, waves=waves, error=str(e)))
+                    break
+                torch.accelerator.synchronize(device)
+                members: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
+                for sm, group in output.view(-1, 2).cpu().tolist():
+                    if sm >= 0:
+                        members.setdefault(group, []).append(sm)
+                        seen.add(sm)
+                for group in members.values():
+                    for sm in group[1:]:
+                        parent[find(sm)] = find(group[0])
+                launches.append(dict(cluster=cluster, waves=waves, clusters=clusters))
+    if len(seen) != nsm:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Placement probe saw {len(seen)} of {nsm} SMs")
+    group_map: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
+    for sm in sorted(seen):
+        group_map.setdefault(find(sm), []).append(sm)
+    groups = sorted(group_map.values(), key=lambda group: group[0])
+    keep, counts = plan_designated(groups)
+    values = [int(sm in keep) for sm in range(nsm + 16)]
+    table.copy_(torch.tensor(values, dtype=torch.int32, device=device))
+    return dict(
+        groups=groups,
+        engine_clusters=counts,
+        designated=sorted(keep),
+        launches=launches,
+    )

+class MoeFrontTP16:
+    def __init__(self, batch: int, *, grid=None, renorm=True):
+        self.batch = batch
+        self.grid = grid if grid is not None else 141 if batch == 1 else 134
+        self.renorm = renorm
+        self.shared_bytes = 15 * 14336 + (512 * batch + 128) * 4 + 16 + 8
+        self.placement = FrontPlacement(batch)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        launch(self.kernel, args, self.grid, 512, min_blocks_per_mp=1)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def gemv(self, rows, nrows, activation, partials, warp, lane):
+        group, quarter = lane // 4, lane % 4
+        acc = zeros((4, 4), Float32)
+        for iteration in cutlass.range_constexpr(14):
+            offset = (warp * 448 + iteration * 32 + 8 * quarter) * 2
+            weight = x = (Uint32(0),) * 4
+            if group < nrows:
+                weight = smem_words(rows + group * 14336 + offset)
+            if group < 2 * self.batch:
+                x = smem_words(activation + (group // 2) * 14336 + offset)
+            b0 = x[2] if (group & 1) != 0 else x[0]
+            b1 = x[3] if (group & 1) != 0 else x[1]
+            chain: cutlass.Constexpr = iteration % 4
+            a = (weight[0], weight[2], weight[1], weight[3])
+            mma_into(acc[chain, None], a, (b0, b1), bf16=True)
+        if (quarter < self.batch) & (group < nrows):
+            chain_sum = lambda c: acc[c, 0] + acc[c, 3]
+            total = (chain_sum(0) + chain_sum(1)) + (chain_sum(2) + chain_sum(3))
+            partials[(warp * 16 + group) * self.batch + quarter] = total
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def gate_pass(self, slots, rows, start, bars, partials, hg, par, tid):
+        wait(bars + 1)
+        warp, lane = tid // 32, tid % 32
+        self.gemv(slots + 9 * 14336, rows, slots + 7 * 14336, partials, warp, lane)
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        if tid < self.batch * rows:
+            token, row = tid // rows, tid % rows
+            total = Float32(0)
+            for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+                total += partials[(w * 16 + row) * self.batch + token]
+            bits = Uint32(gate_bf16_bits(total))
+            pointer = hg.iterator + (par * self.batch + token) * 768 + start + row
+            mailbox_store(pointer, ((bits << 16) | Uint32(1),))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def poll_flag(self, pointer):
+        word = mailbox_load(pointer)[0]
+        while (word & 1) == 0:
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.batch == 2):
+                sleep_ns(128)
+            word = mailbox_load(pointer)[0]
+        return word
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def shared_dot(self, packed, hq, token):
+        value = Float32(0)
+        for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+            w = (*unpack_bf16(packed[chunk, 0]), *unpack_bf16(packed[chunk, 1]))
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(3, -1, -1):
+                value = fma(w[j], hq[token][chunk][j], value)
+        return warp_sum(value, 32)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def load_down(self, down, packed, pair, end_pair, lane, fits=True):
+        for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                words = (Uint32(0), Uint32(0))
+                if fits & (pair + row // 2 < end_pair):
+                    words = early_weights(
+                        down.iterator + (2 * pair + row) * 384 + 4 * (lane + 32 * chunk)
+                    )
+                packed[row, chunk, 0], packed[row, chunk, 1] = words[0], words[1]
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def down_dots(self, packed, values, hq, token):
+        for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            values[token, row] = self.shared_dot(packed[row, None, None], hq, token)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def lane_word(self, values, token, lane):
+        lo = values[token, 0] if lane == 0 else values[token, 2]
+        hi = values[token, 1] if lane == 0 else values[token, 3]
+        return bf16_word(lo, hi)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def store_word(self, output, par3, token, column, word):
+        row = par3 * output.shape[1] + token
+        mailbox_store(output.iterator + row * 7168 + 2 * column, (word,))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def stream_pairs(self, down, hq, output, par3, begin_pair, end_pair, warp, lane):
+        packed = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4, 3, 2), Uint32)
+        values = cute.make_rmem_tensor((self.batch, 4), Float32)
+        for pair in range(begin_pair + 2 * warp, end_pair, 32):
+            self.load_down(down, packed, pair, end_pair, lane)
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.batch):
+                self.down_dots(packed, values, hq, token)
+                if (lane < 2) & (pair + lane < end_pair):
+                    word = self.lane_word(values, token, lane)
+                    self.store_word(output, par3, token, pair + lane, word)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def shared_outputs(self, down, hsm, output, par3, first, end, warp, lane):
+        begin_pair, end_pair = (first + 1) // 2, end // 2
+        hq = [
+            [
+                load_f32x4(hsm.iterator + t * 384 + 4 * (lane + 32 * c), shared=True)
+                for c in range(3)
+            ]
+            for t in range(self.batch)
+        ]
+        packed = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4, 3, 2), Uint32)
+        values = cute.make_rmem_tensor((self.batch, 4), Float32)
+        saved = cute.make_rmem_tensor((3, self.batch), Uint32)
+        fits = (end_pair - begin_pair) <= 96
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.batch == 2):
+            for iteration in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                pair = begin_pair + 2 * warp + 32 * iteration
+                self.load_down(down, packed, pair, end_pair, lane, fits)
+                for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    self.down_dots(packed, values, hq, token)
+                    saved[iteration, token] = self.lane_word(values, token, lane)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.batch == 1) or not fits:
+            self.stream_pairs(down, hq, output, par3, begin_pair, end_pair, warp, lane)
+        boundary = cute.make_rmem_tensor(self.batch, Uint32)
+        if ((end & 1) != 0) & (warp == 0):
+            edge = end // 2
+            for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                    words = early_weights(
+                        down.iterator + (2 * edge + row) * 384 + 4 * (lane + 32 * chunk)
+                    )
+                    packed[row, chunk, 0], packed[row, chunk, 1] = words[0], words[1]
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.batch):
+                lo = self.shared_dot(packed[0, None, None], hq, token)
+                hi = self.shared_dot(packed[1, None, None], hq, token)
+                boundary[token] = bf16_word(lo, hi)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.batch == 2):
+            for iteration in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                pair = begin_pair + 2 * warp + 32 * iteration
+                if fits & (lane < 2) & (pair + lane < end_pair):
+                    for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        word = saved[iteration, token]
+                        self.store_word(output, par3, token, pair + lane, word)
+        if ((end & 1) != 0) & (warp == 0) & (lane == 0):
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.batch):
+                self.store_word(output, par3, token, end // 2, boundary[token])
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        router, bias, xmoe, epoch, scores, ids, weights, down, latent = args[0:9]
+        gate_up, hg, shared_down, output, designated, par, par3, rank = args[9:17]
+        multicast_base, scale, situ = args[17], args[18], args[19:23]
+        tid, warp, lane, cta = thread()
+        router_first, router_rows = split(896, cta, self.grid)
+        pair_first, pairs = split(112, cta, self.grid)
+        gate_first, gate_rows = Int32(0), Int32(0)
+        if cta >= self.batch:
+            part, parts = cta - self.batch, self.grid - self.batch
+            gate_first, gate_rows = split(768, part, parts)
+        slots = alloc(cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator(), Uint8, self.shared_bytes).iterator
+        top, size = 15 * 14336, 256 * self.batch
+        partials = view(slots, top, Float32, size)
+        latent_partial = view(slots, top + 4 * size, Float32, (16, 8), (8, 1))
+        gate_partial = view(slots, top + 4 * size + 512, Float32, size)
+        bars = cute.recast_ptr(slots + top + 8 * size + 512, dtype=Uint64)
+        roles = view(slots, top + 8 * size + 528, Int32, 2)
+        hsm = view(slots, 0, Float32, self.batch * 384)
+        gate_args = (slots, gate_rows, gate_first, bars, gate_partial, hg, par, tid)
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        active_lane = lane < 28
+        first_chunk = 56 * warp + (lane if active_lane else 0)
+        h2_weights = zeros((2, 4 if self.batch == 2 else 2, 4), Uint32)
+        for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(4 if self.batch == 2 else 2):
+                valid = active_lane & (pairs > 0)
+                index = first_chunk + 28 * chunk
+                if cutlass.const_expr(self.batch == 2):
+                    valid = (warp < 7) & (pairs > 0)
+                    index = 32 * warp + lane + 224 * chunk
+                if valid:
+                    pointer = down.iterator + (2 * pair_first + row) * 7168 + index * 8
+                    words = early_weights(pointer, count=4)
+                    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        h2_weights[row, chunk, j] = words[j]
+        if tid == 0:
+            init_barriers(bars, 2, async_proxy=True)
+            claimed = self.placement.claim(epoch, designated, par, cta)
+            stage_rows(slots, 14336, 0, router, router_first, router_rows, bars)
+            if cta == 0:
+                mailbox_store(epoch.iterator + (par ^ 1) * 32, (Uint32(0),))
+                self.placement.rearm(epoch, par)
+            observed = mailbox_load(epoch.iterator + par * 32)[0]
+            while observed < 28 * self.batch:
+                sleep_ns(32)
+                observed = mailbox_load(epoch.iterator + par * 32)[0]
+            role, count = self.placement.role(epoch, par, cta, claimed, self.grid)
+            roles[0], roles[1] = role, count
+        else:
+            if (tid >= 32) & (tid < 32 + self.batch * router_rows):
+                offset = tid - 32
+                token, row = offset // router_rows, offset % router_rows
+                index = ((par ^ 1) * self.batch + token) * 896 + router_first + row
+                mailbox_store(scores.iterator + index * 2, (Uint32(0x80000000),) * 2)
+            if (tid >= 64) & (tid < 64 + self.batch * gate_rows):
+                offset = tid - 64
+                token, row = offset // max(gate_rows, 1), offset % max(gate_rows, 1)
+                index = ((par ^ 1) * self.batch + token) * 768 + gate_first + row
+                hg[index] = Uint32(0)
+            vectors: cutlass.Constexpr = xmoe.shape[1] * xmoe.shape[2] * 896
+            rearm = ((xmoe, vectors, vectors), (latent, 3584, self.batch * 448))
+            for tensor, stride, count in rearm:
+                for vector in range(cta * 511 + tid - 1, count, self.grid * 511):
+                    pointer = tensor.iterator + (par ^ 1) * stride * 8 + vector * 8
+                    mailbox_store(pointer, (Uint32(0x80000000),) * 4)
+        my_bias = Float32(0)
+        if tid < self.batch * router_rows:
+            my_bias = bias[router_first + tid % router_rows]
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        role, count = roles[0], roles[1]
+        shared_resident = role >= 0
+        consumer = shared_resident & ((role & 0x10000) != 0)
+        dense = role & 0xFFFF
+        consumer_token = dense if self.batch == 2 else Int32(0)
+        shared_first, shared_end = Int32(0), Int32(0)
+        if shared_resident:
+            shared_first = 7168 * dense // count
+            shared_end = 7168 * (dense + 1) // count
+        h2 = (warp, lane, pairs) if self.batch == 2 else None
+        words_x, words_h2 = gather_x(
+            xmoe, par, cta, slots + 7 * 14336, first_chunk, active_lane, self.batch, h2
+        )
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.batch == 1):
+            for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                value = Float32(0)
+                if pairs > 0:
+                    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                            w0, w1 = unpack_bf16(h2_weights[row, chunk, j])
+                            x0, x1 = unpack_bf16(words_x[0, chunk, j])
+                            value = fma(w0, x0, fma(w1, x1, value))
+                value = warp_sum(value, 32)
+                if lane == 0:
+                    latent_partial[warp, row] = value
+        elif (warp < 7) & (pairs > 0):
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    value = Float32(0)
+                    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                            w0, w1 = unpack_bf16(h2_weights[row, chunk, j])
+                            x0, x1 = unpack_bf16(words_h2[token, chunk, j])
+                            value = fma(w1, x1, fma(w0, x0, value))
+                    value = warp_sum(value, 32)
+                    if lane == 0:
+                        latent_partial[warp, 2 * token + row] = value
+        cute.arch.sync_warp()
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.batch == 1):
+            if warp == 1:
+                cute.arch.barrier(barrier_id=3, number_of_threads=512)
+            else:
+                named_barrier(3, 512, arrive=True)
+        elif (warp == 1) & (pairs > 0):
+            cute.arch.barrier(barrier_id=3, number_of_threads=224)
+        elif (warp < 7) & (pairs > 0):
+            named_barrier(3, 224, arrive=True)
+        if (warp == 1) & (pairs > 0) & (lane < self.batch):
+            lo, hi = Float32(0), Float32(0)
+            for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(16 if self.batch == 1 else 7):
+                lo += latent_partial[w, 2 * lane]
+                hi += latent_partial[w, 2 * lane + 1]
+            word = bf16_word(lo, hi)
+            offset = par * 8 * 3584 + lane * 3584 + rank * 224 + 2 * pair_first

+def scatter_sums(values, lane, width):
+    """``warp_sum(values[g], width)`` of every g (4 or 8 values) as a reduce-scatter:
+    each butterfly level keeps half of the values and receives the partner's other
+    half, so every partial sum (and the total) is the butterfly's. Returns the lane's
+    total; value g's sits in lanes g << (log2(width) - log2(len(values)))."""
+    values, offset = list(values), width // 2
+    while len(values) > 1:
+        half, upper = len(values) // 2, (lane & offset) != 0
+        kept = []
+        for j in range(half):
+            low, high = values[j], values[half + j]
+            keep = Float32(cutlass.select_(upper, high, low))
+            send = Float32(cutlass.select_(upper, low, high))
+            kept.append(keep + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(send, offset))
+        values, offset = kept, offset // 2
+    total = values[0]
+    while offset >= 1:
+        total += cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(total, offset)
+        offset //= 2
+    return total

+    """Every lane's copy of ``scatter_sums``' first ``count`` totals."""
+    shift = width.bit_length() - padded.bit_length()
+    return [shuffle(total, g << shift) for g in range(count)]
+

+    capacity, 3584 or 7168/TP] are armed with 0x80000000. Only complete chains may use
+    the early B1 trigger, which waits for the predecessor before releasing
+    successors."""

+    threads = 128
+    options: dict = {}
+
+    def __init__(self, tp: int, batch: int, *, mode="front", trigger=2):
+        self.tp, self.batch, self.mode, self.trigger = tp, batch, mode, trigger
+        self.cluster, self.tokens = (7 if tp == 8 else 8), min(batch, 2)
+        self.poll_ns, self.front_poll_ns = (0, 0) if tp == 8 else (64, 128)
+        self.cols, self.shard = 3584 // self.cluster, 7168 // tp
+        self.frags, self.nc = self.cols // 8, self.shard // 32
+        self.grid = self.cluster * self.nc * ((batch + self.tokens - 1) // self.tokens)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        common = dict(cluster=self.cluster, preferred_smem_carveout=100)
+        launch(self.kernel, args, self.grid, self.threads, **common, **self.options)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def poll(self, base, stride, second, second_stride, dual):
+        values = cute.make_rmem_tensor((16, 4), Uint32)
+        sources = (base, stride, second, second_stride)
+        pending = Uint32(0)
+        for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+            if self.tp == 16 or source < 8 or dual:
+                pending |= self.poll_source(values, source, sources)
+        while pending != 0:
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.poll_ns):
+                sleep_ns(Uint32(self.poll_ns))
+            next_pending = Uint32(0)
+            for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+                if (pending & (Uint32(1) << source)) != 0:
+                    next_pending |= self.poll_source(values, source, sources)
+            pending = next_pending
+        return values
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def poll_source(self, values, source: cutlass.Constexpr[int], sources):
+        base, stride, second, second_stride = sources
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.tp == 16 or source < 8):
+            word = load_volatile(base + source * stride, count=4)
+        else:
+            word = load_volatile(second + (source - 8) * second_stride, count=4)
+        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            values[source, k] = word[k]
+        return Uint32(reduce(or_, (v == 0x80000000 for v in word))) << source
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def sum_sources(self, values, start: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+        acc = zeros(8, Float32)
+        for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.tp):
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                acc[k] = acc[k] + bf16(values[source + start, k // 2], k % 2)
+        return acc
+
+    def poll_strides(self, io):
+        if self.mode != "front_poll":
+            return 0, 0, 0
+        return tuple(t.shape[0] // 3 for t in io[2:5])
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def front(self, io, latent_mc, par, rank, capacity, block, warp, lane):
+        _, _, g, weights, s, peers = io
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.mode == "front"):
+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        gs, ws, ss = self.poll_strides(io)
+        start = block + self.grid * warp
+        for task in cutlass.range(start, self.batch * 168, self.grid * 4, unroll=1):
+            if task < self.batch * 56:
+                token, line = task // 56, task % 56
+                src = g.iterator + par * gs + token * 16 * 3584 + 64 * line + 2 * lane
+                wp = weights.iterator + par * ws + token * 16
+                w = cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Uint32)
+                rows = cute.make_rmem_tensor(16, Uint32)
+                dirty = Int32(1)
+                while dirty != 0:
+                    for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        for k, v in enumerate(load_volatile(wp + 8 * h, count=4)):
+                            w[4 * h + k] = v
+                    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+                        rows[j] = load_volatile(src + j * 3584)[0]
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(self.mode == "front_poll"):
+                        words = [w[k] for k in range(8)] + [rows[j] for j in range(16)]
+                        bad = reduce(or_, map(front_dirty, words))
+                        dirty = Int32(cute.arch.vote_any_sync(bad))
+                        if self.front_poll_ns > 0 and dirty != 0:
+                            sleep_ns(Uint32(self.front_poll_ns))
+                    else:
+                        dirty = 0
+                a0, a1 = Float32(0), Float32(0)
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+                    weight = bf16(w[j // 2], j % 2)
+                    a0 = fma(bf16(rows[j]), weight, a0)
+                    a1 = fma(bf16(rows[j], True), weight, a1)
+                word = pack_pair(a0, a1, policy="latent")
+                packed = tuple(shuffle(word, (4 * lane + k) & 31) for k in range(4))
+                if lane < 8:
+                    row = (par * self.tp + rank) * capacity + token
+                    offset = row * 3584 + 64 * line + 8 * lane
+                    multicast_words(latent_mc + Int64(offset) * 2, packed)
+            elif lane < 8:
+                u = task - self.batch * 56
+                token, line = u // 112, u % 112
+                destination = line // (self.shard // 64)
+                own_line = line % (self.shard // 64)
+                src = s.iterator + par * ss + token * 7168 + 64 * line + 8 * lane
+                word = load_volatile(src, count=4)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(self.mode == "front_poll"):
+                    while reduce(or_, map(front_dirty, word)):
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(self.front_poll_ns):
+                            sleep_ns(Uint32(self.front_poll_ns))
+                        word = load_volatile(src, count=4)

+                row = (par * self.tp + rank) * capacity + token
+                offset = row * self.shard + 64 * own_line + 8 * lane
+                store_relaxed(peers[destination] + Int64(offset) * 2, packed)

+    @cute.jit
+    def gemv(self, sw, sx, partial, bars, q, warp, lane, mt: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+        weight, xs, out = sw.iterator, sx.iterator, partial.iterator
+        barrier = bars.iterator + 2
+        acc = zeros(8 * mt, Float32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.tp == 8):
+            # Two bank-spread loads; columns 16*lane .. 16*lane+15 accumulate in order.
+            swap = (lane >> 2) & 1
+            xl = cute.make_rmem_tensor((mt, 8), Uint32)
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(mt):
+                aa, bb = spread(xs + token * self.cols, lane, swap)
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    xl[token, k] = bb[k] if swap != 0 else aa[k]
+                    xl[token, k + 4] = aa[k] if swap != 0 else bb[k]
+            for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                wa, wb = spread(weight + (warp * 8 + row) * self.cols, lane, swap)
+                for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(mt):
+                    value = acc[row * mt + token]
+                    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                        ww = (wb + wa)[k] if swap != 0 else (wa + wb)[k]
+                        value = fma_bf16(ww, xl[token, k], value)
+                        value = fma_bf16(ww, xl[token, k], value, high=True)
+                    acc[row * mt + token] = value
+        elif lane < 28:
+            for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                chunk = lane + 28 * half
+                x = [smem_words(xs + t * self.cols + 8 * chunk) for t in range(mt)]
+                for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    ww = smem_words(weight + (warp * 8 + row) * self.cols + 8 * chunk)
+                    for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(mt):
+                        value = acc[row * mt + token]
+                        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                            value = fma_bf16(ww[k], x[token][k], value)
+                            value = fma_bf16(ww[k], x[token][k], value, high=True)
+                        acc[row * mt + token] = value

+        value, selected = scatter_reduce(acc, lane, 8 * mt)
+        if (lane & ((4 if mt == 1 else 2) - 1)) == 0:
+            row, token = selected // mt, selected % mt
+            push_float(out + (q * 32 + warp * 8 + row) * mt + token, value, barrier, 0)

+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):

+        peers, output, latent_mc, output_mc, par, rank, capacity, eps = args[7:15]

+        block, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()

+            else:

+        cute.arch.sync_warp()

+                pair = pack_pair(out, shuffle(out, (lane + 1) & 31), policy="latent")
+                words = tuple(shuffle(pair, (8 * lane + 2 * k) & 31) for k in range(4))

+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.mode == "front_poll"):

+    @cute.jit
+    def rearm(self, io, capacity, parity, batch, block, tid, reduced=None):
+        """Re-arms ``parity``'s first ``batch`` tokens (and WaveMoeTail's reduced
+        rows)."""
+        latent, shared, g, w, s, _ = io
+        if parity >= 0:
+            nl, nr = self.tp * batch * 448, self.tp * batch * (self.shard // 8)
+            ng, nw, ns = Int32(0), Int32(0), Int32(0)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.mode == "front_poll"):
+                gs, ws, ss = self.poll_strides(io)
+                ng = min(batch, gs // (16 * 3584)) * 16 * 448
+                nw = min(batch, ws // 16) * 2
+                ns = min(batch, ss // 7168) * 896
+            elif cutlass.const_expr(reduced is not None):
+                ng = batch * 448
+            ring = (parity, capacity, batch)
+            start, step = block * self.threads + tid, self.grid * self.threads
+            for i in cutlass.range(start, nl + nr + ng + nw + ns, step, unroll=1):
+                if i < nl:
+                    self.rearm_row(latent, 3584, i, ring)
+                elif i < nl + nr:
+                    self.rearm_row(shared, self.shard, i - nl, ring)
+                elif cutlass.const_expr(self.mode == "front_poll"):
+                    j = i - nl - nr
+                    fill = (Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF),) * 4
+                    if j < ng:
+                        store_words(g.iterator + parity * gs + 8 * j, fill)
+                    elif j < ng + nw:
+                        store_words(w.iterator + parity * ws + 8 * (j - ng), fill)
+                    else:
+                        store_words(s.iterator + parity * ss + 8 * (j - ng - nw), fill)
+                elif cutlass.const_expr(reduced is not None):
+                    rows = reduced.iterator + parity * capacity * 3584
+                    store_words(rows + 8 * (i - nl - nr), (Uint32(0x80000000),) * 4)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def rearm_row(self, box, width: cutlass.Constexpr[int], i, ring):
+        parity, capacity, batch = ring
+        row, frag = i // (width // 8), i % (width // 8)
+        source, token = row // batch, row % batch
+        dst = box.iterator + ((parity * self.tp + source) * capacity + token) * width
+        store_words(dst + 8 * frag, (Uint32(0x80000000),) * 4)

+def pow2_spans(n):
+    """(start, count) spans of n columns, power-of-two counts, largest first."""
+    bits = [1 << i for i in reversed(range(n.bit_length())) if n >> i & 1]
+    return tuple((sum(bits[:i]), b) for i, b in enumerate(bits))

+
+class WaveMoeTail(MoeTail):
+    """One-wave tail over published inputs (TP8 B5+, TP16 B9+): seven 16-CTA clusters
+    split K into 224-column slices of a 128-row (TP16: 64-row) tile. Weight fragments
+    stay in registers through the latent poll, RMS all-gather and normalization; row
+    warps (TP16: two sets taking alternate groups) run two seven-step BF16 MMA chains
+    per 8-token group, and each 64-row output line has one owner CTA and one multicast
+    writer. Past one group (and at TP16) each cluster instead all-reduces every seventh
+    token of its slices once and shares them as BF16 rows through ``reduced``, so all
+    112 CTAs must be co-resident; RS lines spread over warp pairs, every group's RMS
+    sums travel as one vector per peer, all groups normalize before any MMA, the
+    groups' MMA chains interleave per K step, and the previous layer's rows are
+    re-armed after the output multicast. ``twoshot`` (B9+): the latent
+    mailbox is this rank's ``common.twoshot`` receive slots [3, TP, capacity, 3584/TP]
+    (pushed by the experts), the CTAs of its owned slices reduce them like TP16 but
+    multicast the rows into every rank's ``reduced`` (the gather; its multicast
+    address replaces the latent one), so each GPU receives 2 x B x 7 KB of latent
+    instead of TP x B x 7 KB."""
+
+    threads, options = 256, dict(min_blocks_per_mp=1)
+
+    def __init__(self, batch, tp=8, twoshot=False, early=False, umma=False):
+        super().__init__(tp, batch, mode="publish")
+        assert not twoshot or batch > 8
+        assert not umma or batch > 8
+        # ``early``: release the next AttnRes at entry, so its block statistics and
+        # exchange overlap this kernel (it reads only earlier layers' data before its
+        # Lamport poll of the output rows), instead of after the output multicast.
+        self.early = early
+        self.lines, self.groups = 2 if tp == 8 else 1, (batch + 7) // 8
+        self.slots = (batch * self.lines + 15) // 16  # owned output lines per CTA
+        self.twoshot, self.width = twoshot, 3584 // tp if twoshot else 3584
+        # Past one group (and at TP16) clusters share reduced latent rows; TP8 B<=8
+        # polls its sources directly.
+        self.reduce = self.groups > 1 or tp == 16
+        self.grid, self.poll_ns, self.cluster = 112, 64, 16
+        # Shared memory: per group x [8, 224] BF16 and MMA partials [8 warps, 8, 16]
+        # (TP16 pads to whole warp sets); gathered squares (one group keeps each
+        # slice's 28 lane sums, more one sum); per owned line its partials [16 slices,
+        # 64] and RS rows [64]; two barriers.
+        n, s = self.groups + self.groups % (2 // self.lines), self.slots
+        # Past one group each (warp, slice) row holds the groups' sums, padded to v4.
+        self.padded = -(-self.groups // 4) * 4
+        self.squares = 3584 if n == 1 else 128 * max(n, self.padded)
+        partials = 7680 * n + 4 * self.squares
+        self.offsets: tuple = (3584 * n, 7680 * n, partials, partials + 4096 * s)
+        self.offsets += (partials + 4352 * s + 32,)
+        self.smem = 116 * 1024  # one CTA per SM
+        # ``umma`` (past one group): the CTA's [M, 224] x [N, 224] up projection on
+        # tcgen05 (M = 64 x lines rows, N = the padded tokens, K padded to 256) from
+        # 128B-swizzled W and x tiles (W: four TMA boxes [M, 64] at entry, the last
+        # running into the next slice, whose columns meet the zeroed x padding; the
+        # weight argument is then the shard's tensor map), D in TMEM, staged as
+        # [token, row] in the drained W tiles for the owners' pushes. FP32
+        # accumulation in the tensor core's order.
+        self.umma = umma
+        if umma:
+            self.m = 64 * self.lines
+            self.n = -(-8 * self.groups // (16 if self.lines == 2 else 8))
+            self.n *= 16 if self.lines == 2 else 8
+            self.columns = max(32, 1 << (self.n - 1).bit_length())
+            w_bytes, x_bytes = self.m * 512, self.n * 512
+            squares = w_bytes + x_bytes
+            partials = squares + 4 * self.squares
+            self.offsets = (0, squares, partials, partials + 4096 * s)
+            self.offsets += (partials + 4352 * s + 32,)
+            self.smem = max(self.smem, self.offsets[4] + 40)
+
+    def group_smem(self, sm, g):
+        """Group g's x (BF16 pointer) and MMA partials."""
+        x = view(sm, 3584 * g, BFloat16, 1792).iterator
+        return x, view(sm, self.offsets[0] + 4096 * g, Float32, 1024)
+
+    def line_smem(self, sm, s):
+        """Owned line s's partials [16 slices, 64] and RS rows."""
+        partial, rs = self.offsets[2:4]
+        cells = view(sm, partial + 4096 * s, Float32, 1024)
+        return cells, view(sm, rs + 256 * s, Float32, 64)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        latent, shared, weight, gamma = args[0:4]
+        output_mc, par, rank, capacity, eps = args[10:15]
+        tid, warp, lane, block = thread()
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.early):
+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        q = cute.arch.block_idx_in_cluster()
+        n, batch, lines, rows = self.groups, self.batch, self.lines, 64 * self.lines
+        row0, gq, tq, owner = block // 16 * rows, lane // 4, lane % 4, q < lines * batch
+        own_token, own_line = q // lines, q % lines
+        rs_j, lat = 4 * warp + lane - 28, lane < 28
+        owns = lambda s: owner if s == 0 else q < lines * batch - 16 * s
+        rs_lane = lambda g: (lane >= 28) & owns(g) & (rs_j < 8)
+        align = 1024 if self.umma else 128
+        sm = alloc(cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator(), Uint8, self.smem, align).iterator

+            pending |= Uint32(reduce(or_, (v == 0x80000000 for v in words))) << source
+        while pending != 0:
+            sleep_ns(Uint32(self.poll_ns))
+            again = Uint32(0)
+            for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.tp):
+                if (pending & (Uint32(1) << source)) != 0:
+                    again |= self.poll_row(values, source, ptr + source * stride)

+    @cute.jit
+    def push(self, *args):

+    @cute.kernel
