+            offset += column % self.shard
+            packed = tuple(no_neg_zero(w) for w in words)
+            store_relaxed(peers[column // self.shard] + Int64(offset) * 2, packed)

+"""Routed MoE tail: one fused kernel finalizes this rank's top-16 rows, multicasts the
+latent partial and peer-stores the shared shard (three rotating parities), all-reduces
+and RMS-normalizes per K-slice, runs the K-split up projection and multicasts the output
+row into the next AttnRes mailbox. At TP8 B5+ and TP16 B9+ the experts publish the
+latent partial, WaveMoeTail.push the shared shard and WaveMoeTail does the rest. At
+``twoshot_batches`` the latent all-reduce is ``common.twoshot``: the experts push each
+partial chunk to its column owner, whose WaveMoeTail CTAs sum and multicast it."""
+
+from functools import cache
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import BFloat16, Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint8
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+from ..common.host import fake, prepare_shared_carveout, stream, tensor_maps, to_cute
+from ..common.policy import batch_table
+from ..common.twoshot import TwoShot
+from ..oproj.prepared import OprojMailbox
+from .tail import MoeTail, WaveMoeTail
+
+# MoE tail mailbox tokens (padded decode batches); small-batch front_poll G/W/S rows per
+# parity.
+CAP, POLL_CAP = 64, 8
+# Two-shot latent all-reduce batches per TP (B9+): 2-/4-node GB300, us/layer of RS push
+# + experts + WaveMoeTail, max over ranks, multicast vs two-shot: TP8 B16 41.74/42.80,
+# B32 52.20/53.18, B64 79.27/81.50; TP16 B16 33.98/34.49, B32 42.19/42.52, B64
+# 65.05/60.51.
+TWOSHOT = {8: "", 16: "33-64:1"}
+# WaveMoeTail batches that release the next AttnRes at entry.
+EARLY = {8: "9-64:1", 16: "9-64:1"}
+# WaveMoeTail batches whose up projection runs on tcgen05 (B9+; 1-GPU WaveMoeTail us
+# mma.sync vs tcgen05, B16/32/64: TP8 4.53/5.80/9.05 vs 4.45/5.26/7.80, TP16 two-shot
+# 4.50/5.39/7.75 vs 4.52/5.46/7.21).
+UMMA = {8: "9-64:1", 16: "33-64:1"}
+
+
+def flat(t):
+    return to_cute(t.reshape(-1), 16)
+
+
+def published(tp, batch):
+    """The experts publish the latent and WaveMoeTail runs the tail (else MoeTail
+    front)."""
+    return batch > (4 if tp == 8 else 8)
+
+
+def twoshot_batches(tp):
+    table = batch_table(TWOSHOT.get(tp, ""))
+    return {batch for batch, on in table.items() if on and batch > 8}
+
+
+def early_batches(tp):
+    table = batch_table(EARLY.get(tp, ""))
+    return {batch for batch, on in table.items() if on and published(tp, batch)}
+
+
+def umma_batches(tp):
+    table = batch_table(UMMA.get(tp, ""))
+    return {batch for batch, on in table.items() if on and batch > 8}
+
+
+def shares(tp, batch, twoshot=False):
+    """WaveMoeTail clusters share reduced latent rows (all 112 CTAs must be
+    co-resident)."""
+    return published(tp, batch) and WaveMoeTail(batch, tp, twoshot).reduce
+
+
+@cache
+def resident_clusters(device):
+    """Co-resident 16-CTA clusters at one CTA per SM."""
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device):
+        return cutlass.utils.HardwareInfo(device).get_max_active_clusters(16)
+
+
+class MoeTailBox:
+    """Model-owned MoE tail mailboxes: latent [3, TP, CAP, 3584] (multicast), shared
+    reduce-scatter [3, TP, CAP, 7168/TP] (peer stores), output [1, CAP, 7168], the
+    local all-reduced latent rows [3, CAP, 3584] that WaveMoeTail clusters share and the
+    two-shot latent buffers (``twoshot_args``/``twoshot_tail`` replace args/tail)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, group, device, tp, rank):
+        self.rank = rank
+        self.latent = OprojMailbox(group, device, tp, rank, (3, tp, CAP, 3584))
+        self.rs = OprojMailbox(group, device, tp, rank, (3, tp, CAP, 7168 // tp))
+        self.out = OprojMailbox(group, device, tp, rank, (1, CAP, 7168))
+        ptrs = self.rs.handle.buffer_ptrs
+        self.peers = torch.tensor(ptrs, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self.args = (flat(self.latent.buffer), flat(self.rs.buffer))
+        self.tail: tuple = (to_cute(self.peers, 16), flat(self.out.buffer))
+        self.tail += (Int64(self.latent.mc), Int64(self.out.mc))
+        self.reduced = torch.empty((3, CAP, 3584), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        self.reduced.view(torch.int32).fill_(-0x80000000)
+        self.twoshot = box = TwoShot(group, device, tp, rank, 3584, CAP, parities=3)
+        self.twoshot_args = (flat(box.recv), self.args[1])
+        self.twoshot_tail = (*self.tail[:2], Int64(box.gather_mc), self.tail[3])
+        # Experts' push: every parity's receive slots [3 x TP, CAP, 3584/TP] and the
+        # owners' buffer bases (slot parity x TP + rank).
+        self.push_box = (
+            to_cute(box.recv.view(3 * tp, CAP, -1)),
+            to_cute(box.peers[0], 16),
+        )
+
+
+@cache
+def compile_tail(tp, batch, device, mode="front", trigger=2, early=False, umma=False):
+    """front: rows complete at the PDL wait; front_poll: three 0xffff-armed G/W/S parity
+    slots polled per row and re-armed after use; publish (``published``): WaveMoeTail
+    over the published mailboxes, reading the weight shard directly, not by TMA;
+    twoshot: publish over the two-shot receive slots and gather."""
+    m8, twoshot = mode in ("publish", "twoshot"), mode == "twoshot"
+    vec = lambda n, dtype=BFloat16, align=16: fake((n,), None, dtype, align)
+    slots = 3 * POLL_CAP if mode == "front_poll" else batch
+    latent = 3 * tp * CAP * (3584 // tp if twoshot else 3584)
+    tensors: tuple = (vec(latent), vec(3 * tp * CAP * (7168 // tp)))
+    weights = vec(7168 // tp * 3584) if m8 and not umma else vec(128, Uint8, 64)
+    tensors += (weights, vec(3584))
+    tensors += (vec(slots * 16 * 3584), vec(slots * 16), vec(slots * 7168))
+    tensors += (vec(tp, Int64), vec(CAP * 7168))
+    scalars: tuple = (Int64(0), Int64(0), Int32(0), Int32(0), Int32(CAP), Float32(1e-6))
+    scalars += (Int32(2), Int32(CAP))
+    kernel: MoeTail
+    if m8:
+        kernel = wave = WaveMoeTail(batch, tp, twoshot, early, umma)
+        scalars += (vec(3 * CAP * 3584),) if wave.reduce else ()
+    else:
+        kernel = MoeTail(tp, batch, mode=mode, trigger=trigger)
+    options = "" if m8 else "--ptxas-options=--maxrregcount=120"
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device):
+        args = (*tensors, *scalars, make_fake_stream())
+        code = cute.compile(kernel, *args, options=options)
+        # MoE tail requests 100% shared carveout so the next large PDL kernel can
+        # coexist.
+        return prepare_shared_carveout(code, device, 100)
+
+
+@cache
+def compile_push(batch, device, tp=8):
+    args = (fake((batch, 7168)), fake((tp,), None, Int64), Int32(0), Int32(0))
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device):
+        return cute.compile(
+            WaveMoeTail(batch, tp).push, *args, Int32(CAP), make_fake_stream()
+        )

+
+class MoeTailWeights:
+    """One layer's up-projection shard [7168/TP, 3584], RMS weight and TMA map."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tp, weight, gamma, eps, ordinal, count, batches, twoshots=()):
+        self.weight, self.gamma = weight, gamma
+        # Three parities rotate over the model's MoE layers; each launch re-arms the
+        # previous MoE layer's slots of its batch (wrapping across decode steps, where
+        # the first layer re-arms the largest batch the last layer may have published).
+        parity, rearm = ordinal % 3, (ordinal - 1) % count % 3
+        if parity == rearm:  # a launch must never re-arm the slots it publishes to
+            raise ValueError(f"MoE tail parities collide for {count} MoE layers")

+        self.scalars = (Int32(CAP), Float32(eps), rearm)

+        cols = 512 if tp == 8 else 448
+        u16 = cuda.CUtensorMapDataType.CU_TENSOR_MAP_DATA_TYPE_UINT16
+        dims = (cols // 2, 3584 // (cols // 2), 7168 // tp)
+        spec: tuple = (weight.data_ptr(), u16, dims, (cols, 7168), (cols // 2, 2, 32))
+        spec += (cuda.CUtensorMapSwizzle.CU_TENSOR_MAP_SWIZZLE_NONE,)
+        spec += (cuda.CUtensorMapL2promotion.CU_TENSOR_MAP_L2_PROMOTION_NONE,)
+        self.descriptor = tensor_maps([spec], weight.device)
+        self.views = (to_cute(self.descriptor, 64), to_cute(gamma, 16))
+        self.codes, device, early = {}, weight.device.index, early_batches(tp)
+        umma = umma_batches(tp)
+        if any(published(tp, b) and b in umma for b in batches):
+            # WaveMoeTail tcgen05: [64 x lines, 64] boxes of the shard, 128B swizzle
+            spec = (weight.data_ptr(), u16, (3584, 7168 // tp), (7168,))
+            spec += ((64, 128 if tp == 8 else 64),)
+            spec += (cuda.CUtensorMapSwizzle.CU_TENSOR_MAP_SWIZZLE_128B,)
+            spec += (cuda.CUtensorMapL2promotion.CU_TENSOR_MAP_L2_PROMOTION_L2_256B,)
+            self.umma_map = tensor_maps([spec], weight.device)
+            self.umma_views = (to_cute(self.umma_map, 64), self.views[1])
+        for b in batches:  # WaveMoeTail reads the shard directly, not by TMA
+            twoshot = b in twoshots
+            mode = "twoshot" if twoshot else "publish" if published(tp, b) else "front"
+            views = self.views if mode == "front" else (flat(weight), self.views[1])
+            on = mode != "front" and b in umma
+            views = self.umma_views if on else views
+            code = compile_tail(tp, b, device, mode, early=b in early, umma=on)
+            self.codes[b] = code, views, shares(tp, b, twoshot), twoshot
+        shared = any(shares(tp, b, b in twoshots) for b in batches)
+        if shared and resident_clusters(device) < 7:
+            raise RuntimeError("WaveMoeTail needs seven co-resident 16-CTA clusters")
+
+    def run(self, box, expanded, weights, shared, code=None, batch=None):
+        batch = batch or weights.shape[0]
+        if code is None:
+            code, views, share, twoshot = self.codes[batch]
+        else:
+            views, share, twoshot = self.views, 0, False
+        args, tail = box.args, box.tail
+        if twoshot:
+            args, tail = box.twoshot_args, box.twoshot_tail
+        rows = (flat(expanded), flat(weights), flat(shared), *tail, self.parity)
+        rows += (Int32(box.rank), *self.scalars, Int32(self.wrap or batch))
+        if share:
+            rows += (flat(box.twoshot.gather if twoshot else box.reduced),)
+        code(*args, *views, *rows, stream(expanded.device))
+
+
+class PreparedTail:
+    """The layer's MoE tail; placement = (model MoeTailBox, MoE ordinal, MoE layer
+    count). At WaveMoeTail batches the experts publish into latent slot ``publish[b]``
+    (multicast, parity, rank; at ``twoshots`` the two-shot push box) and the side
+    stream pushes the shared-expert output (``push``)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, op, norm, up, batches, placement):
+        tp, rank = op.contract.tp_size, op.rank
+        local_up = up.narrow(0, rank * (7168 // tp), 7168 // tp)
+        self.tail_box, ordinal, count = placement
+        eps = op.contract.rms_eps

+        self.twoshots = twoshot_batches(tp) & set(m8)
+        args = (tp, local_up, norm, eps, ordinal, count, batches, self.twoshots)
+        self.tail_weights = MoeTailWeights(*args)
+        self.peers, _, mc, _ = self.tail_box.tail

+        self.publish.update({b: (*self.tail_box.push_box, slot) for b in self.twoshots})
+
+    def push(self, shared):
+        if shared.shape[0] in self.pushers:
+            args = (to_cute(shared), self.peers, *self.ring, Int32(CAP))
+            self.pushers[shared.shape[0]](*args, stream(shared.device))
+
+    def run(self, expanded, weights, shared, out, *, consume):
+        self.tail_weights.run(self.tail_box, expanded, weights, shared)
+        if consume(out) is not out:
+            raise RuntimeError("The tail output must be consumed from its mailbox ring")
+        return out

+"""O-projection all-reduce consumer (``groups`` 128-thread groups poll disjoint
+rank slots, group 0 sums in rank order into the AttnRes) and TP16 fused producer +
+consumer. With ``twoshot`` the mailbox is the one-slot gather row of

+@asm((Float32,) * 2, pure=True)
+def pair_op(a, b, c=(), *, op="add"):
+    values = (*a, *b, *c)
+    code = "{ .reg .b64 a,b,c,d; mov.b64 a,{$2,$3}; mov.b64 b,{$4,$5}; "
+    if op == "fma":
+        code += "mov.b64 c,{$6,$7}; fma.rn.f32x2 d,a,b,c; "
+    else:
+        code += f"{op}.rn.f32x2 d,a,b; "
+    constraints = ",".join(["=f", "=f"] + ["f"] * len(values))
+    return code + "mov.b64 {$0,$1},d; }", constraints, tuple(map(Float32, values))
+
+
+@asm(Float32, pure=True)
+def mul_rn(a, b):
+    return "mul.rn.f32 $0,$1,$2;", "=f,f,f", (*(Float32(v) for v in (a, b)),)
+
+
+def two(values, j):
+    return values[2 * j], values[2 * j + 1]
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def dot8(a, b):
+    s0 = pair_op(two(a, 0), two(b, 0), op="mul")
+    s1 = pair_op(two(a, 1), two(b, 1), op="mul")
+    s0 = pair_op(two(a, 2), two(b, 2), s0, op="fma")
+    s1 = pair_op(two(a, 3), two(b, 3), s1, op="fma")
+    s = pair_op(s0, s1)
+    return add_rn(s[0], s[1])
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def reduce_scatter(values, size: cutlass.Constexpr[int], lane):
+    """Warp-reduce ``size`` values; returns the index of the one this lane holds."""
+    for shift in cutlass.range_constexpr(4, -1, -1):
+        live: cutlass.Constexpr = max(1, size >> (4 - shift))
+        half: cutlass.Constexpr = max(1, live // 2)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(live == 1):
+            values[0] = add_rn(
+                values[0], cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(values[0], 1 << shift)
+            )
+        else:
+            upper = (lane & (1 << shift)) != 0
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(half):
+                send, keep = values[j + half], values[j]
+                if upper:
+                    send, keep = values[j], values[j + half]
+                values[j] = add_rn(keep, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(send, 1 << shift))
+    idx = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    for shift in cutlass.range_constexpr(4, -1, -1):
+        width: cutlass.Constexpr = size >> (4 - shift)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(width > 1):  # noqa: SIM102
+            if (lane & (1 << shift)) != 0:
+                idx += width // 2
+    return idx
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def fetch(raw, rank, pointer):
+    words = load_vector(pointer, cache="volatile")
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        raw[rank, j] = words[j]
+
+
+class OprojConsumer:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        nb,
+        *,
+        has_delta=True,
+        groups=4,
+        twoshot=False,
+    ):
+        if not 0 <= nb <= 8:
+            raise ValueError("Output-projection AttnRes supports zero to eight blocks")
+        self.nb, self.has_delta = nb, has_delta
+        self.groups, self.twoshot = groups, twoshot
+        self.kpre = 1 << max(0, (2 * nb - 1).bit_length())
+        self.npost = 4 if nb > 0 else 1

+    @cute.jit
+    def wait_exchange(self, barrier):
+        wait_phase_zero(barrier)  # peers complete it by st.async
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def allocate(self):
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        wpre = alloc(smem, Float32, (4, 16))
+        pre = alloc(smem, Float32, (7, 16))
+        blk = alloc(smem, Float32, 16)
+        post = alloc(smem, Float32, (7, 4, 4))
+        total = alloc(smem, Float32, 4)
+        bars = alloc(smem, cutlass.Uint64, 2, 8)
+        parts = alloc(smem, Float32, (max(1, self.groups - 1), 2, 128, 4))
+        lean = self.groups == 1  # above B8: rows for this nb only (co-residency)
+        pf = alloc(smem, Uint32, (4 + self.nb if lean else 12, 128, 4))
+        return wpre, pre, blk, post, total, bars, parts, pf
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def setup(self, bars):
+        arm_exchanges(bars, (2 * self.nb, 4 * self.npost))
+        cute.arch.cluster_arrive_relaxed()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def prefetch(self, args, pf, rank, token):

+    def slots(self, tp):

+    @cute.jit
+    def poll_sum(self, mailbox, token, h, first, count):

+    @cute.jit

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Output projection fused with its TP all-reduce and post-attention AttnRes: rank
+partials go into Lamport slots of a multicast [TP, 64, 7168] mailbox (parity alternates
+by layer) and the consumer sums and re-arms them. TP16 B<=8 fuses producer and consumer
+(MLA layers below B5 keep them split); above B8 the producer runs 16-token groups.
+At ``twoshot_batches``, given ``TwoShot`` buffers, the all-reduce is ``common.twoshot``
+(chunks pushed to their column owner, owner sums + multicasts, all Lamport-polled), so
+each GPU receives ~2 x 14 KB per token instead of TP x 14 KB."""
+
+from functools import cache
+from typing import Any
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+from ..common.host import dynamic_fake, dynamic_view, fake, stream, to_cute
+from ..common.policy import batch_table
+from .consumer import OprojConsumer, OprojFused
+from .producer import OprojProducer, OprojUmma
+
+
+class OprojMailbox:
+    """Sentinel-armed multicast mailbox; defaults to [parity, TP, 64, 7168] BF16."""
+
+    def __init__(self, group, device, tp, rank, shape=None):
+        self.tp, self.rank = tp, rank
+        shape = (2, tp, 64, 7168) if shape is None else shape
+        self.buffer = symm_mem.empty(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        self.handle = handle = symm_mem.rendezvous(self.buffer, group)
+        self.mc = int(handle.multicast_ptr or 0)
+        if not self.mc:  # slot() offsets this address
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Kimi K3 specialized o-projection needs multicast memory"
+            )
+        self.buffer.view(torch.int32).fill_(-0x80000000)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize(device)
+        torch.distributed.barrier(group=group)
+
+    def slot(self, parity):
+        return self.buffer[parity], self.mc + parity * self.buffer[0].numel() * 2
+
+
+# Two-shot all-reduce batches per TP (2-/4-node GB300, 32 MLA layers, us/layer, max over
+# ranks, multicast vs two-shot: TP8 B16 8.85/11.40, B32 10.63/11.32, B64 18.06/13.18;
+# TP16 B16 9.78/12.28, B32 14.96/13.05, B64 28.06/14.07).
+TWOSHOT = {8: "33-64:1", 16: "17-64:1"}
+
+
+def twoshot_batches(tp):
+    table = batch_table(TWOSHOT.get(tp, ""))
+    return {batch for batch, on in table.items() if on}
+
+
+def engine(batch, tp):
+    """Producer engine above B8 (GB300): grouped mma.sync for TP8 up to B16, else
+    tcgen05."""
+    default = "mma" if tp == 8 and batch <= 16 else "umma"
+    return default
+
+
+def producer(k, batch, tp, mla, twoshot=False, kind=None):
+    """B<=8: one mma.sync pass, TP8 stages 8 (MLA 4) of 12 K blocks per warp. Above
+    B8 (``kind`` overrides ``engine``): the tcgen05 engine, or 2-tile warps over 8 K
+    parts in 16-token groups, TP8 staging 2 of 6 K blocks per warp."""
+    if batch <= 8:
+        staged = 0 if tp == 16 else 4 if mla else 8
+        return OprojProducer(k, staged_blocks=staged, twoshot=twoshot)
+    if (kind or engine(batch, tp)) == "umma":
+        return OprojUmma(k, twoshot=twoshot)
+    grouped = dict(rows=2, group_tiles=2, twoshot=twoshot)
+    return OprojProducer(k, staged_blocks=0 if tp == 16 else 2, **grouped)
+
+
+@cache
+def compile_oproj(
+    kind, k, batch, tp, nb, has_delta, mla, front=False, cap=64, twoshot=False
+):
+    """Producer, consumer or fused kernel over a [TP, cap, 7168] parity view;
+    ``front``: the consumer also publishes x_moe [1, 4, 7168] and the epoch hint.
+    ``twoshot``: the two-shot pair (arguments as ``TwoShot.views``)."""
+    box = fake((1 if twoshot else tp, cap, 7168), (cap * 7168, 7168, 1))
+    x, w = fake((batch, k), (k, 1)), fake((7168, k), (k, 1))
+    mc, slot, eps = cutlass.Int64(0), cutlass.Int32(0), cutlass.Float32(1e-6)
+    recv, peers = fake((tp, cap, 7168 // tp)), fake((tp,), None, torch.int64)
+    if kind.startswith("producer"):  # producer_mma / producer_umma: engine A/B
+        kernel = producer(k, batch, tp, mla, twoshot, kind[9:] or None)
+        tail = (recv, peers, slot) if twoshot else (box, mc, slot)
+        return cute.compile(kernel, x, w, *tail, make_fake_stream())
+    row, weight = dynamic_fake(2), fake((7168,), (1,))
+    xmoe = fake((1, 4, 7168), (4 * 7168, 7168, 1)) if front else None
+    hints = fake((224,), (1,), torch.int32) if front else None
+    rows = (row, dynamic_fake(3), weight, weight, weight, row, xmoe, hints, eps, eps)
+    if kind == "consumer":  # B64: one 128-thread group per CTA polls every rank
+        options = dict(has_delta=has_delta)
+        groups = 4 if batch <= 32 and not twoshot else 1
+        kernel = OprojConsumer(nb, groups=groups, twoshot=twoshot, **options)
+        extra = (recv, mc, slot) if twoshot else ()
+        return cute.compile(kernel, box, *rows, *extra, make_fake_stream())
+    kernel = OprojFused(nb, has_delta=has_delta)
+    return cute.compile(kernel, x, w, box, mc, slot, *rows, make_fake_stream())
+
+
+class PreparedOproj:
+    """One decoder layer's o-projection + all-reduce + post-attention AttnRes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, decoder, mailbox, batches, mla, front=None, twoshot=None):
+        weight = decoder.self_attn.o_proj.weight
+        norm, out_norm = decoder.mlp_res_norm, decoder.post_attention_layernorm
+        weights = (norm.weight, decoder.mlp_res_proj.weight.squeeze(0), out_norm.weight)
+        self.views = tuple(to_cute(w.reshape(-1)) for w in weights)
+        self.eps = tuple(cutlass.Float32(n.variance_epsilon) for n in (norm, out_norm))
+        parity, rank = decoder.layer_idx % 2, cutlass.Int32(mailbox.rank)
+        local_box, mc = mailbox.slot(parity)
+        self.device, self.box = weight.device, to_cute(local_box)
+        self.head = (self.box, cutlass.Int64(mc), rank)
+        self.twoshot: Any = None
+        if twoshot is not None:
+            recv, peers, gather, gather_mc = twoshot.views(parity)
+            recv = to_cute(recv)
+            self.twoshot = (
+                (recv, to_cute(peers), rank),
+                to_cute(gather),
+                (recv, cutlass.Int64(gather_mc), rank),
+            )
+        self.wview, tp, k = to_cute(weight), mailbox.tp, weight.shape[1]
+        nb = decoder.prev_valid_blocks + decoder.is_block_write_layer
+        delta = not decoder.is_block_write_layer
+        self.front = None if front is None else (*map(to_cute, front[:2]), front[2])
+        self.codes, self.twoshots = {}, twoshot_batches(tp) if self.twoshot else set()
+        for b in batches:
+            publish = front is not None and b in front[2]
+            fused = tp == 16 and (not mla or b >= 5) and b <= 8
+            kinds = ("fused",) if fused else ("producer", "consumer")
+            twoshot = b in self.twoshots and not fused
+            shape = (k, b, tp, nb, delta, mla)
+            self.codes[b] = tuple(
+                compile_oproj(kind, *shape, publish and kind != "producer", 64, twoshot)
+                for kind in kinds
+            )
+
+    def run(self, local, prefix, blocks, out):
+        batch, s = local.shape[0], stream(self.device)
+        codes, x = self.codes[batch], to_cute(local)
+        front = (None, None)
+        if self.front is not None and batch in self.front[2]:
+            front = self.front[:2]
+        rows = (dynamic_view(prefix), dynamic_view(blocks), *self.views)
+        rows += (dynamic_view(out), *front, *self.eps, s)
+        if len(codes) == 1:
+            codes[0](x, self.wview, *self.head, *rows)
+        elif batch in self.twoshots:
+            head, gather, tail = self.twoshot
+            codes[0](x, self.wview, *head, s)
+            codes[1](gather, *rows[:-1], *tail, s)
+        else:
+            codes[0](x, self.wview, *self.head, s)
+            codes[1](self.box, *rows)
+        return out, prefix, blocks

+"""O-projection producer for the split and fused AttnRes paths: 112 CTAs of 64 output
+rows. Each warp keeps ``rows`` 16-row weight tiles of one of ``4 * rows`` K parts in
+registers (TP8 stages some K blocks in shared memory), runs BF16 MMA chains and the K
+parts are reduced in order. Weights load before the PDL wait; the split producer
+triggers its consumer right after it. With ``group_tiles`` the batch runs in groups of
+that many 8-token tiles: each group's x arrives through a double-buffered cp.async ring
+during the previous group's MMAs, and is reduced and published during the next one's.
+With ``twoshot`` the partial chunks go to their owners' receive slots instead (the
+first shot of ``common.twoshot``; args 2-4: receive view, owners' bases, rank).

+def pack8(values, policy="plain"):
+    """Four BF16x2 words of ``values[0:8]``."""
+    return tuple(
+        pack_pair(values[2 * j], values[2 * j + 1], policy=policy) for j in range(4)
+    )
+
+
+def tree_reduce(values, op):
+    tree = list(values)
+    for stride in (1, 2, 4):
+        for block in range(0, len(tree) - stride, 2 * stride):
+            tree[block] = op(tree[block], tree[block + stride])
+    return tree[0]

+class OprojProducer:
+    def __init__(self, k, *, staged_blocks, rows=1, group_tiles=0, twoshot=False):
+        self.k, self.staged, self.rows = k, staged_blocks, rows
+        self.twoshot = twoshot
+        self.parts = 4 * rows
+        self.kblocks = k // (32 * self.parts)
+        self.register_blocks = self.kblocks - self.staged
+        self.group_tiles = group_tiles

+        self.shared_x = self.staged > 0 and not group_tiles
+        self.register_x = k == 768 and not group_tiles
+        self.x_stride = k // 8 + 4
+        self.chains = max(1, 4 // (rows * max(1, group_tiles)))

+    def schedule(self, batches):
+        """(8-token tiles, tiles per group, groups) of ``batches`` tokens."""
+        tiles = (batches + 7) // 8

+        return tiles, per_group, (tiles + per_group - 1) // per_group

+    @cute.jit
+    def allocate(self, batches: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):

+        return red, xs, staged

+    @cute.jit
+    def load_weight(self, weight, staged, cta):

+                    src = weight.iterator + base + t * 16 * self.k
+                    src += (self.register_blocks + j) * 32
+                    stage_weight(dst, src)
+                    stage_weight(dst + 128, src + 8 * self.k)
+            cute.arch.cp_async_commit_group()
+        wr = cute.make_rmem_tensor((self.register_blocks, self.rows, 2, 4), Uint32)
+        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.register_blocks):
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.rows):
+                for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    src = weight.iterator + base + (t * 2 + r) * 8 * self.k + j * 32
+                    words = load_vector(src, cache="weight")
+                    for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        wr[j, t, r, v] = words[v]
+        return wr

+    @cute.jit
+    def stage_x(self, x, xs, first: Constexpr[int], buffer: Constexpr[int]):

+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        chunks: Constexpr = self.k // 8
+        count: Constexpr = min(x.shape[0] - first, self.group_tiles * 8)
+        rows: Constexpr = buffer * self.group_tiles * 8
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr((count * chunks + 511) // 512):
+            chunk = tid + i * 512
+            token, col = chunk // chunks, chunk % chunks
+            dst = xs.iterator + ((rows + token) * self.x_stride + col) * 4
+            if cutlass.const_expr((i + 1) * 512 <= count * chunks):
+                copy_g2s(dst, at(x, first + token, col * 8))
+            else:
+                if chunk < count * chunks:  # noqa: SIM102
+                    copy_g2s(dst, at(x, first + token, col * 8))
+        cute.arch.cp_async_commit_group()
+
+    def x_words(self, xs, row, kofs, j):
+        return smem_words(xs.iterator + (row * self.x_stride + kofs // 8 + j * 4) * 4)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def multiply(self, smem, wr, xr, first: Constexpr, buffer: Constexpr, M: Constexpr):
+        """FP32 chains of tokens [first, first + group); x from ``xr`` (registers) or
+        shared-memory rows (ring ``buffer``)."""
+        red, xs, staged = smem
+        _, gt, _ = self.schedule(M)
+        tiles: Constexpr = min(gt, (M - first + 7) // 8)
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        lane, warp = tid % 32, tid // 32
+        group, part = lane // 4, lane % 4
+        kofs = warp % self.parts * self.kblocks * 32 + part * 8
+        acc = cute.make_rmem_tensor((gt, self.rows, self.chains, 4), Float32)
+        acc.fill(0)
+        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.kblocks):
+            wa, wb = [], []
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.rows):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(j < self.register_blocks):
+                    wa.append(tuple(wr[j, t, 0, v] for v in range(4)))
+                    wb.append(tuple(wr[j, t, 1, v] for v in range(4)))
+                else:
+                    sj: Constexpr = j - self.register_blocks
+                    unit = (warp * self.staged + sj) * self.rows + t
+                    ptr = staged.iterator + (unit * 2 * 32 + lane) * 4
+                    wa.append(smem_words(ptr))
+                    wb.append(smem_words(ptr + 128))
+            for nt in cutlass.range_constexpr(tiles):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(self.register_x):
+                    xv = tuple(xr[nt, j, v] for v in range(4))
+                else:
+                    row = buffer * gt * 8 + nt * 8
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(self.group_tiles):
+                        xv = self.x_words(xs, row + group, kofs, j)
+                    else:

+                        if nt * 8 + group < M:
+                            xv = self.x_words(xs, row + group, kofs, j)
+                for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.rows):
+                    for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        chain: Constexpr = (j * 2 + half) % self.chains
+                        a: tuple = (wa[t][2 * half], wb[t][2 * half])
+                        a += (wa[t][2 * half + 1], wb[t][2 * half + 1])
+                        b = (xv[2 * half], xv[2 * half + 1])

+
+    @cute.jit
+    def store_partials(self, red, acc, tiles: Constexpr):
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        lane, warp = tid % 32, tid // 32
+        group, part = lane // 4, lane % 4
+        tile, kq = warp // self.parts * self.rows, warp % self.parts
+        for nt in cutlass.range_constexpr(tiles):
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.rows):
+                for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    chains = [acc[nt, t, c, v] for c in range(self.chains)]
+                    token, row = 2 * part + v % 2, group + (v // 2) * 8
+                    red[nt, tile + t, kq, token, row] = tree_reduce(chains, add_rn)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def publish(self, args, red, cta, first: Constexpr[int]):
+        """Sum the K parts of tokens [first, first + group) in order; multicast them."""
+        x, _, mailbox, mc, slot = args[:5]
+        _, gt, _ = self.schedule(x.shape[0])
+        count: Constexpr = min(x.shape[0] - first, gt * 8)
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        if tid < 8 * count:
+            reduced = cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Float32)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.group_tiles):
+                # Token-major lanes: conflict-free 16-byte partial loads.
+                token, out_half = tid % count, tid // count % 2
+                row_tile = tid // count // 2
+                tile, row = token // 8, token % 8
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    column = out_half * 8 + i * 4
+                    words = smem_words(at(red, tile, row_tile, 0, row, column))
+                    sums = [bits_float(w) for w in words]
+                    for q in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, self.parts):
+                        words = smem_words(at(red, tile, row_tile, q, row, column))
+                        sums = [add_rn(s, bits_float(w)) for s, w in zip(sums, words)]
+                    for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        reduced[i * 4 + v] = sums[v]

+                out_half, row_tile, token = tid % 2, (tid // 2) % 4, tid // 8
+                tile, row = token // 8, token % 8

+                    value = red[tile, row_tile, 0, row, out_half * 8 + v]
+                    for q in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, self.parts):
+                        part = red[tile, row_tile, q, row, out_half * 8 + v]

+                push(mailbox, mc, slot, first + token, out_col, words)
+            else:
+                offset = cute.crd2idx((slot, first + token, out_col), mailbox.layout)
+                multicast_words(mc + Int64(offset) * 2, words)

+    @cute.jit
+    def compute(self, args, smem, wr, cta, trigger_after_wait: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+        x = args[0]
+        red, xs, staged = smem
+        M: Constexpr = x.shape[0]

+        group, part = lane // 4, lane % 4

+    def __call__(self, *args):

+    @cute.kernel

+    stream 128B-swizzled W [64, 64] and x [N, 64] K blocks through a cp.async ring

+    warp accumulates D [64, N] FP32 in TMEM with M=64 kind::f16 MMAs, and the loader
+    warps round D to BF16 and publish it like ``OprojProducer``."""

+    def __init__(self, k, *, twoshot=False, budget=184 * 1024):
+        super().__init__(k, staged_blocks=0, twoshot=twoshot)
+        self.blocks, self.budget = k // 64, budget

+    def geometry(self, batches):
+        """(N, ring stage bytes, stages, TMEM columns)."""
+        n = (batches + 7) // 8 * 8
+        stage = 8192 + n * 128
+        stages = min(self.blocks, self.budget // stage)
+        return n, stage, stages, max(32, 1 << (n - 1).bit_length())

+        128B-swizzled tile; rows >= ``valid`` are left alone. ``valid`` < 0: weights
+        (evict-first, every row)."""
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()

+            c = tid + 128 * i
+            row, chunk = c // 8, c % 8

+            src = at(source, row0 + row, column + chunk * 8)

+                stage_weight(dst, src)
+            elif cutlass.const_expr((i + 1) * 128 <= valid * 8):

+            else:

+    @cute.jit
+    def multiply(self, ring, bars, tmem, n: Constexpr, stage: Constexpr):

+        stages: Constexpr = self.geometry(n)[2]

+
+
+class Step(NamedTuple):
+    q: int  # tokens per request
+    metadata: list  # per layer
+    slot_mapping: Any
+
+
+def layer_name(module):
+    return getattr(module, "prefix", getattr(module, "layer_name", None))
+
+
+def decode_metadata(attention, context, q, b):
+    """One layer's metadata if this step is a pure decode (q = 1) or a uniform
+    verify step of b tokens, else None."""
+    md = context.attn_metadata
+    md = md.get(layer_name(attention)) if isinstance(md, dict) else None
+    if md is None:
+        return None
+    if q > 1:
+        return md if is_uniform_verify(md, q, b) else None
+    if md.num_prefills or getattr(md, "num_spec_decodes", 0):
+        return None
+    return md
+
+
+def is_uniform_verify(md, q, b):
+    """Whether every request of the b // q graph rows verifies q tokens (FULL graphs
+    pad whole requests: KDA stages NULL state rows, MLA zero-length decodes)."""
+    if md.num_prefills:
+        return False
+    if not hasattr(md, "num_spec_decodes"):
+        return md.num_decode_tokens == md.num_decodes * q == b
+    rows, tokens = md.spec_state_indices_tensor, md.num_spec_decode_tokens
+    full = rows is not None and rows.shape[0] * q == b
+    return full and not md.num_decodes and tokens == md.num_spec_decodes * q

+        # verify graphs round each capture size up to whole requests.

+        - token counts without prepared providers (above 64 or not in ``batches``);
+        - steps outside a CUDA graph capture (profiling, warmup and the warmup run
+          before each capture), so every stock kernel runs before its capture;
+        - PIECEWISE steps, keyed by token count alone and so captured as stock;
+        - steps with prompt rows (prefills, chunked prefills, fresh prompts);
+        - speculative steps whose requests do not all verify q tokens (partial
+          drafts, verify rows mixed with plain decode rows).

+        decode need every rank to take the same path.

+            return None

+            return None
+        if not is_forward_context_available():

+        by_layer = context.attn_metadata
+        rows: list[Any] = list(by_layer.values()) if isinstance(by_layer, dict) else []

+        if b % q:
+            return None
+        metadata = [decode_metadata(d.self_attn, context, q, b) for d in self.layers]
+        if any(md is None for md in metadata):

+        return Step(q, metadata, context.slot_mapping)

+    def run(self, step, input_ids, inputs_embeds):
+        """Normalized hidden states (and the aux streams) of a planned step."""

+        aux_out = [torch.empty_like(x) for _ in self.aux_layers]

+        """A stock step's output with the backbone's final norm applied, as the
+        specialized decode's last AttnRes applies it; the aux streams stay pre-norm.

+            hidden = torch.cat([norm(hidden[i : i + 255], None) for i in chunks])
+        else:
+            hidden = norm(hidden, None)
+        return hidden if aux is None else (hidden, aux)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""L2 weight prefetch for the specialized decode.
+
+Small-batch decode is bound by HBM bandwidth, and each kernel that starts on weights
+not yet in L2 stalls on DRAM. Some kernels leave bandwidth idle, such as the attention
+core and the all-reduces. At fixed points of each layer, this module launches a small
+kernel (``cutedsl/common/prefetch.py``) on a side stream. It pulls the byte ranges of
+the weights the next kernels read into L2, so that they start warm.
+
+Prefetch points (``fork(point, layer, batch)``), each with its batches per TP:
+
+- ``oproj_down``: after the o-projection (B3-8), the MoE front's packed
+  router + latent-down rows.
+- ``attention_moe``: at TP8 only, after the KDA input projection (B5-8) or the MLA
+  core (B8), the same front rows plus the shared expert's weights.
+- ``next_attention``: once the routed experts are launched, the next layer's
+  attention weights, capped in MiB per batch (``NEXT_ATTENTION``). Not above B8,
+  where the HBM-bound experts lose more bandwidth than the attention gains.
+
+The front and shared-expert ranges are on the critical path. They launch with the
+highest stream priority and the maximum shared-memory carveout, which needs a driver
+launch because CuTe drops both attributes.
+
+Each fork records an event on the main stream that the side stream waits on, so a
+prefetch starts only after the work it overlaps. ``join()`` at the end of the step
+makes the main stream wait for the side stream, so a captured graph always rejoins
+it. This lives in ``runtime/`` rather than ``cutedsl/`` because it is host-side
+orchestration across layers: a stream, events, and per-(point, layer, batch) tables
+built from the model's layers.
+"""
+
+import ctypes
+from functools import partial
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import torch
+
+from ...ops.cute_dsl.latent_moe_tail.primitives import to_cute
+from ..cutedsl.common.host import _checked, resolve_kernel
+from ..cutedsl.common.policy import batch_table
+from ..cutedsl.common.prefetch import compile_kernel
+
+# Per-TP batch -> MiB cap (or cap.carveout) of the next layer's attention weights,
+# prefetched once the routed experts finish.
+# Not at B>8: the HBM-bound experts lose more bandwidth than the attention gains.
+NEXT_ATTENTION = {8: "1:96.100,2-3:96,4-7:64,8:32", 16: "1-8:1024"}
+
+
+def attention_weights(attention):
+    """Next-attention weights in their consumption order."""
+    names = (
+        *("in_proj_qkvgfab", "fused_qkv_a_g_proj", "fused_qkv_a_proj", "q_proj"),
+        *("kv_a_proj_with_mqa", "f_b_proj", "q_b_proj", "g_proj"),
+    )
+    weights = [getattr(getattr(attention, n, None), "weight", None) for n in names]
+    weights += [getattr(attention, "W_UK_T", None), getattr(attention, "W_UV", None)]
+    weights = [w for w in weights if isinstance(w, torch.Tensor)]
+    return (*weights, attention.o_proj.weight)
+
+
+class PreparedWeightRanges:
+    """One owner retains weights, immutable range table, executable and launch ABI."""
+
+    def __init__(self, weights, *, byte_cap=0, grid=32, carveout=None, priority=False):
+        self.weights = weights = tuple(weights)
+        device = weights[0].device
+        ranges, remaining = [], byte_cap
+        for weight in weights:
+            if weight.numel() == 0:
+                continue
+            if weight.data_ptr() % 16:  # the kernel walks 16-byte aligned chunks
+                raise ValueError("L2 prefetch ranges must start 16-byte aligned")
+            span = 1 + sum((n - 1) * s for n, s in zip(weight.shape, weight.stride()))
+            size = span * weight.element_size()
+            if byte_cap:
+                size = min(size, remaining) // 16 * 16
+                remaining -= size
+            if size:
+                ranges.append((weight.data_ptr(), size))
+            if byte_cap and remaining < 16:
+                break
+        self.table = torch.tensor(ranges, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self.compiled = compile_kernel(len(ranges), grid, carveout, device.index)
+        self.config = None
+        if not priority and carveout is None:
+            self.views = to_cute(self.table, 16)
+            return
+        # Launch priority / carveout need a driver launch (CuTe drops both).
+        self.executor, self.function = resolve_kernel(self.compiled, device.index)
+        ids, self.attributes = cuda.CUlaunchAttributeID, []
+        if priority:  # the greatest stream priority
+            top = cuda.CUlaunchAttribute()
+            top.id = ids.CU_LAUNCH_ATTRIBUTE_PRIORITY
+            top.value.priority = _checked(cuda.cuCtxGetStreamPriorityRange())[1]
+            self.attributes.append(top)
+        if carveout is not None:
+            smem = cuda.CUlaunchAttribute()
+            smem.id = ids.CU_LAUNCH_ATTRIBUTE_PREFERRED_SHARED_MEMORY_CARVEOUT
+            smem.value.sharedMemCarveout = carveout
+            self.attributes.append(smem)
+        config = self.config = cuda.CUlaunchConfig()
+        config.gridDimX, config.gridDimY, config.gridDimZ = grid, 1, 1
+        config.blockDimX, config.blockDimY, config.blockDimZ = 32, 1, 1
+        config.sharedMemBytes, config.attrs = 0, self.attributes
+        config.numAttrs = len(self.attributes)
+        self.pointer = ctypes.c_void_p(self.table.data_ptr())
+        self.arguments = (ctypes.c_void_p * 1)(ctypes.addressof(self.pointer))
+        self.address = ctypes.addressof(self.arguments)
+
+    def launch(self, stream):
+        if self.config is None:
+            self.compiled(self.views, stream)
+        else:
+            self.config.hStream = stream
+            _checked(cuda.cuLaunchKernelEx(self.config, self.function, self.address, 0))
+
+
+class PrefetchController:
+    """Prefetch launches per (point, layer, batch) on one side stream."""
+
+    def __init__(self, runtime, layers, packed):
+        self.device, tp = runtime.device, runtime.tp
+        self.stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=self.device)
+        self.events, self.pending, self.tables = {}, False, {}
+        urgent = partial(PreparedWeightRanges, carveout=100, priority=True)
+        following = batch_table(NEXT_ATTENTION[tp])
+        for position, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            if not layer.is_moe_layer:
+                continue
+            index, moe, attention = layer.layer_idx, layer.mlp, layer.self_attn
+            # The front GEMM reads [router shard; down shard] from the packed copy.
+            ranges = urgent((packed[index],), grid=8)
+            self._add("oproj_down", index, range(3, 9), ranges)
+            if tp == 8:
+                shared = moe.shared_experts
+                shared = shared.gate_up_proj.weight, shared.down_proj.weight
+                ranges = urgent((packed[index], *shared), grid=32)
+                batches = range(5, 9) if hasattr(attention, "in_proj_qkvgfab") else (8,)
+                self._add("attention_moe", index, batches, ranges)
+            if position + 1 < len(layers):
+                weights = attention_weights(layers[position + 1].self_attn)
+                self._add_capped("next_attention", index, weights, following)
+
+    def _add_capped(self, point, layer, weights, table):
+        groups: dict[tuple, list[int]] = {}
+        for batch, spec in table.items():
+            cap, carveout = spec if isinstance(spec, tuple) else (spec, None)
+            if cap:
+                groups.setdefault((cap, carveout), []).append(batch)
+        for (cap, carveout), batches in groups.items():
+            ranges = PreparedWeightRanges(
+                weights, byte_cap=cap * 1024**2, grid=32, carveout=carveout
+            )
+            self._add(point, layer, batches, ranges)
+
+    def _add(self, point, layer, batches, ranges):
+        key = point, layer
+        if key not in self.events:
+            event = torch.cuda.Event()
+            event.record(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))
+            self.events[key] = event
+        for batch in batches:
+            self.tables[point, layer, batch] = ranges
+
+    def fork(self, point, layer, batch):
+        ranges = self.tables.get((point, layer, batch))
+        if ranges is None:
+            return False
+        event = self.events[point, layer]
+        event.record(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))
+        self.stream.wait_event(event)
+        self.pending = True
+        ranges.launch(cuda.CUstream(self.stream.cuda_stream))
+        return True
+
+    def join(self):
+        if self.pending:
+            torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device).wait_stream(self.stream)
+            self.pending = False

+"""Per-layer attention providers (input projection, KDA/MLA core, o-projection) and
+the helpers ``SpecializedDecode.build_providers`` uses."""

+from typing import Any

+import torch

+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl.skinny_gemm import (
+    SkinnyGemmConfig,
+    shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm,

+from ..cutedsl.mla.prepared import PreparedMla
+from ..cutedsl.oproj.prepared import PreparedOproj

+# Decode batches (tokens) served by the prepared providers: every batch up to 8, the
+# padded CUDA-graph batches and each further captured size; others run stock.
+BATCHES = (*range(1, 9), 16, 32, 64)
+PREPARED_MAX = BATCHES[-1]
+
+
+def projection_policies(tp, rows, batches):
+    """Split-K (M tile, N tile, split, stages) per execution rows' next tested bin."""
+    policies = {}
+    for batch in batches:
+        n = next(b for b in (8, 16, 32, 64) if batch <= b)
+        if rows == 6288 and (tp == 8 or n > 8):
+            tactic = (64, 64, 1, 6) if n == 64 else (128, n, 2, 5 if n == 32 else 6)
+        else:  # TP16 KDA B64: a sixth stage, -0.7 us per layer in the KDA chain
+            stages = {8: 8, 16: 10, 32: 8, 64: 6 if rows == 3216 else 5}[n]
+            tactic = (64, n, 4 if n == 8 else 2, stages)
+        policies[batch] = tactic
+    return policies
+
+
+class SkinnyProjection:
+    """B1/B2 skinny GEMM; static K loads two weight tiles before the PDL wait."""
+
+    def __init__(self, weight, fallback):
+        self.weight, self.fallback, k = weight, fallback, weight.shape[1]
+        tactics = {1: (128, 4, 1), 2: (64, 4, 2)}
+        self.configs = {m: SkinnyGemmConfig(m, *t, 8, k) for m, t in tactics.items()}
+        for m, cfg in self.configs.items():  # compile before capture
+            shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm(weight.new_zeros(m, k), weight, cfg, None)
+
+    def run(self, x, out):
+        cfg = self.configs.get(x.shape[0])
+        if cfg is None:
+            return self.fallback.run(x, out)
+        return shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm(x, self.weight, cfg, None)
+
+
+def scratch(runtime, name, shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+    if name not in runtime.buffers:
+        runtime.buffers[name] = torch.empty(shape, device=runtime.device, dtype=dtype)
+    return runtime.buffers[name]
+
+
+class Attention:
+    """Input projection -> KDA/MLA core -> o-projection with its fused AttnRes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, decoder, runtime, prefetch, mailbox, small_batch, twoshot=None):
+        attention, tp = decoder.self_attn, runtime.tp
+        self.kind = kind = "kda" if hasattr(attention, "in_proj_qkvgfab") else "mla"
+        name = "in_proj_qkvgfab" if kind == "kda" else "fused_qkv_a_g_proj"
+        weight = getattr(attention, name).weight
+        pitch = weight.shape[0]
+        policies = projection_policies(tp, pitch, runtime.batches)
+        split_k = PreparedProjection(weight, policies).prepare()
+        self.projection = SkinnyProjection(weight, split_k)
+        self.core: Any  # PreparedKda or PreparedMla
+        if kind == "kda":
+            mode = lambda b: (1 if b == 1 else 2 if b <= 8 else 0) if tp == 8 else 0
+            policies = {b: (pitch, mode(b)) for b in runtime.batches}
+            q = runtime.q  # verify steps: B requests x q tokens
+            verify = [b // q for b in runtime.batches if q > 1 and b % q == 0]
+            policies.update({(b, q): (pitch, int(tp == 8)) for b in verify})
+            self.core = PreparedKda(attention, policies, is_conv_state_dim_first())
+        else:
+            heads = attention.num_local_heads
+            query = scratch(runtime, "mla.query", (64, heads, 576), torch.uint8)
+            policy = dict(max_context=runtime.max_context, core=runtime.mla_core)
+            policy.update(queries=runtime.queries)
+            if runtime.dcp > 1:
+                policy.update(
+                    dcp=dcp_box(runtime, heads), parity=runtime.mla_layers % 2
+                )
+            runtime.mla_layers += 1
+            pitches = {b: pitch for b in runtime.batches}
+            self.core = PreparedMla(attention, pitches, query, **policy)
+        parity = decoder.layer_idx % 2
+        front: tuple | None = None
+        if decoder.is_moe_layer:
+            front = small_batch.front_views[parity], small_batch.hint_views[parity]
+            front += (small_batch.batches,)
+        self.output = PreparedOproj(
+            decoder, mailbox, runtime.batches, kind == "mla", front, twoshot
+        )
+        projected = scratch(runtime, kind + ".projected", (64, pitch))
+        local = scratch(runtime, "attention.local", (64, 12288 // tp))
+        self.prefetch, self.layer = prefetch, decoder
+        self.storage = {b: (projected[:b], local[:b]) for b in range(1, 65)}
+
+    def prepare_layout(self, caches):
+        if self.kind == "kda":
+            self.core.prepare_caches(caches)
+        else:
+            self.core.prepare_cache(caches[0])
+
+    def run(self, x, out, prefix, blocks, caches, metadata, slot_mapping, q=1):
+        b = x.shape[0]
+        projected, local = self.storage[b]
+        projected = self.projection.run(x, projected)
+        if self.kind == "kda":
+            self.prefetch.fork("attention_moe", self.layer.layer_idx, b)
+            if q > 1:  # uniform q-token verify rows
+                slots = metadata.spec_state_indices_tensor
+                accepted = metadata.num_accepted_tokens
+                self.core.run(
+                    projected, local, caches=caches, slots=slots, accepted=accepted
+                )
+            else:
+                slots = metadata.non_spec_state_indices_tensor
+                self.core.run(projected, local, caches=caches, slots=slots)
+        else:
+            decode = metadata.decode
+            tables, lengths = decode.block_table, decode.seq_lens
+            # Request metadata shorter than b: the core runs the prepared batch b
+            # with the missing rows as empty requests.
+            rows = min(b, q * min(lengths.numel(), tables.shape[0]))
+            if rows < b:
+                local[rows:].zero_()
+            slots = slot_mapping[self.layer.self_attn.layer_name]
+            mla = dict(cache=caches[0], block_table=tables, lengths=lengths)
+            # DCP: lengths are the local shard's, totals the full sequences'.
+            mla.update(totals=decode.dcp_tot_seq_lens)
+            self.core.run(projected, local, slots=slots, q=q, **mla)
+            self.prefetch.fork("attention_moe", self.layer.layer_idx, b)
+        self.output.run(local, prefix, blocks, out)
+        self.prefetch.fork("oproj_down", self.layer.layer_idx, b)
+        return out
+
+
+def dcp_box(runtime, heads):
+    """The model's DCP mailboxes (one set for every MLA layer)."""
+    if runtime.dcp_box is None:
+        from vllm.distributed import get_dcp_group
+
+        group = get_dcp_group()
+        assert group.world_size == runtime.dcp == runtime.tp
+        from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config
+
+        args = group.device_group, runtime.device, group.world_size, group.rank_in_group
+        parallel = get_current_vllm_config().parallel_config
+        interleave = parallel.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size
+        runtime.dcp_box = DcpBox(*args, heads, interleave=interleave)
+    return runtime.dcp_box
+
+
+def pack_front(moe, rank, tp):
+    """[this rank's router rows (padded to 16); this rank's latent down shard]."""
+    router, down = moe.gate.weight, moe.routed_expert_down_proj.weight
+    rows, shard = 896 // tp, 3584 // tp
+    router = router[rank * rows : (rank + 1) * rows]
+    down = down[rank * shard : (rank + 1) * shard]
+    return torch.cat((router, router.new_zeros((-rows % 16, 7168)), down)).detach()

+    """Lifecycle phases shared for an epoch-scoped external EEP operation.
+
+    These values are stored in the control and reconfiguration stores and
+    exposed through the status API so external orchestrators can observe the

+class ExternalElasticEPScaleUpHandshakeServer:
+    """Temporary rank-0 handshake server for external EEP scale-up.
+
+    During normal external startup the global handshake listener only exists
+    while the rank starts. Scale-up needs the same handshake contract again for
+    newly launched ranks, so rank 0 re-opens a temporary listener for the
+    duration of the current scale operation.
+
+    The handshake gives new ranks the information they cannot infer locally:
+    front-end and DP coordinator ZMQ addresses, the new DP master address/ports,
+    target DP size, target expert redundancy, and the coordination store port
+    used for EEP reconfiguration.

+    def __init__(
+        self,

+        num_redundant_experts: int,
+        elastic_ep_max_dp_size: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.handshake_address = handshake_address
+        self.expected_new_ranks = set(expected_new_ranks)
+        self.addresses = addresses
+        self.bootstrap = bootstrap
+        self.num_redundant_experts = num_redundant_experts
+        self.elastic_ep_max_dp_size = elastic_ep_max_dp_size
+        self.started_event = Event()
+        self._stop_event = Event()
+        self._thread = Thread(
+            target=self._run,
+            name="ExternalElasticEPHandshakeServer",
+            daemon=True,
+        )
+        self._error: Exception | None = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        self._thread.start()
+        started = self.started_event.wait(timeout=5)
+        if self._error is not None:
+            raise self._error
+        if not started:
+            raise TimeoutError(
+                "Timed out waiting for external EEP handshake server to "
+                f"start listening at {self.handshake_address}"
+            )
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        self._stop_event.set()
+        if self._thread.is_alive():
+            self._thread.join(timeout=5)
+        if self._error is not None:
+            raise self._error

+        if self._error is not None:

+    def _run(self) -> None:

+                    router_handover=True,

+                poller.register(handshake_socket, zmq.POLLIN)

+                    if not pending_ready_ranks:

+                    if handshake_socket not in events:

+                    engine_rank = int.from_bytes(engine_identity, "little")
+                    if engine_rank not in self.expected_new_ranks:
+                        raise RuntimeError(
+                            "Received scale-up handshake from unexpected "
+                            f"dp rank {engine_rank}"
+                        )
+
+                    message = msgspec.msgpack.decode(payload)
+                    status = message["status"]
+                    if status == "HELLO":
+                        b = self.bootstrap

+                            "data_parallel_master_ip": b.new_data_parallel_master_ip,
+                            "data_parallel_master_port": (

+                            "_data_parallel_master_port_list": (

+                            "data_parallel_size": b.new_data_parallel_size,
+                            "_coord_store_port": b.coord_store_port,

+                                    parallel_config=parallel_config,

+                                num_redundant_experts=self.num_redundant_experts,
+                                elastic_ep_max_dp_size=self.elastic_ep_max_dp_size,
+                            )
+                        )
+                        handshake_socket.send_multipart(
+                            (engine_identity, init_message), copy=False
